exercises.name: Ab Scissors
exercises.summary: A seated leg cross for the lower abs. Keep your legs straight.
steps: Sit on a mat and lean back onto your hands.
Lift both feet a few inches up, legs straight.
Cross your right leg over your left, then swap.
Keep alternating and breathing steadily until your abs tire.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel
exercises.summary: A rollout for the whole midsection. Only go as far as your back stays flat.
steps: Kneel and hold the wheel on the floor with both hands.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Roll forward as far as you can keep a flat back.
Pull the wheel back under you and breathe out.

exercises.name: Aerobics
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Air Bike
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Around The World
exercises.summary: A wide arc over the chest. Keep the arms straight and the weight light.
steps: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell over each thigh, palms down.
Keep your arms straight and breathe in.
Sweep the dumbbells in a wide arc to behind your head.
Sweep them back to your thighs and breathe out.

exercises.name: Chest Dip (Assisted)
exercises.summary: A chest dip with the machine taking part of your weight.
steps: Set the assist weight and kneel or stand on the pad.
Grip the bars and lean your torso forward.
Lower until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Chin Up (Assisted)
exercises.summary: An underhand pull-up with the machine helping you up.
steps: Set the assist weight and kneel or stand on the pad.
Grip the bar shoulder-width with palms facing you.
Pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Assisted Pistol Squats
exercises.summary: A one-legged squat holding a rack for balance.
steps: Stand beside a rack and hold it with one hand.
Lift one foot and reach that leg forward.
Breathe in and squat as low as you can control.
Push through your heel to stand and breathe out.
Finish your reps, then swap legs.

exercises.name: Pull Up (Assisted)
exercises.summary: A pull-up with the machine taking part of your weight.
steps: Set the assist weight and kneel or stand on the pad.
Grip the bar just wider than your shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar, leading with your elbows.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip (Assisted)
exercises.summary: An upright dip with the machine helping you up.
steps: Set the assist weight and kneel or stand on the pad.
Grip the bars and keep your torso upright.
Lower until your elbows reach ninety degrees.
Press back up to straight arms.

exercises.name: Ball Slams
exercises.summary: A whole-body throw. Slam it down hard and pick it up with a flat back.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width and hold the ball at your stomach.
Brace your abs and lift the ball straight overhead.
Breathe in, then slam it down hard in front of your feet.
Bend your knees to pick it up with a flat back.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row (Band)
exercises.summary: A hinged row against a band, which is hardest at the top.
steps: Stand on the middle of the band and hold both handles.
Hinge forward with a flat back until your torso is near parallel.
Set your shoulders back and breathe in.
Pull both handles to your ribs until your elbows pass your torso.
Squeeze, breathe out, and straighten your arms slowly.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Band)
exercises.summary: A wide arc against the band. Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
steps: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold an end in each hand.
Step forward with your arms out to the sides, elbows soft.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Open your arms slowly back to the sides.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Band)
exercises.summary: A press with the band anchored behind you at chest height.
steps: Anchor the band behind you at chest height and hold an end in each hand.
Step forward to take up the slack and stagger your feet.
Press both hands forward until your arms are straight.
Bring them back to your chest under control.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Band)
exercises.summary: A hinge against band tension. Good for grooving the pattern.
steps: Stand on the middle of the band and hold an end in each hand.
Soften your knees and brace your abs.
Push your hips back and lower your hands down your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Band)
exercises.summary: A front-delt raise against the band. Stop at shoulder height.
steps: Stand on the middle of the band and hold an end in each hand.
Brace your abs and keep your arms almost straight.
Raise your hands forward to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Band)
exercises.summary: A neutral-grip curl against the band.
steps: Stand on the middle of the band and hold an end in each hand.
Turn your palms to face each other and pin your elbows.
Curl both hands up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Kneeling Pulldown (band)
exercises.summary: A kneeling pulldown against a band anchored overhead.
steps: Anchor a band above you and kneel holding both ends.
Start with your arms straight overhead.
Pull your elbows down and back toward your ribs.
Let your arms rise slowly under control.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Band)
exercises.summary: A vertical pull with the band anchored overhead.
steps: Anchor the band above you and kneel holding an end in each hand.
Start with your arms straight overhead.
Pull your elbows down and back toward your ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then let your arms rise slowly.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Band)
exercises.summary: A side raise against the band. Tension rises as you lift.
steps: Stand on the middle of the band and hold an end in each hand.
Soften your elbows and brace your abs.
Raise both arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Pull Up (Band)
exercises.summary: A pull-up with a band under your foot taking some of your weight.
steps: Loop a band over the bar and put one foot or knee in it.
Grip the bar just wider than your shoulders.
Pull your chest toward the bar, leading with your elbows.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Band Pullaparts
exercises.summary: A rear-delt opener. High reps, light band, squeeze the blades.
steps: Hold the band with both hands, arms straight out in front.
Set your shoulders back and breathe in.
Pull the band apart until your arms reach your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, breathe out, and return slowly.

exercises.name: Squat (Band)
exercises.summary: A squat against band tension, which is hardest at the top.
steps: Stand on the middle of the band with feet shoulder-width.
Bring the ends over your shoulders and hold them there.
Breathe in and squat until your thighs reach parallel.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Behind the Back Wrist Curl (Barbell)
exercises.summary: Forearm flexion with the bar behind your legs.
steps: Stand with a barbell behind you, palms facing back.
Hold the bar at arm's length against your glutes.
Breathe in and curl the bar using only your wrists.
Breathe out at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.summary: The main upper-body press. Shoulder blades pinned, feet planted.
steps: Lie back and grip the bar just wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulder blades together and plant your feet flat.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest.
Breathe in and lower it to touch your lower chest.
Press up until your elbows lock and breathe out.

exercises.name: Bench Press - Close Grip (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A bench press with the hands in, which shifts load to the triceps.
steps: Lie back and grip the bar shoulder-width apart.
Pull your shoulder blades together and plant your feet.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest.
Breathe in and lower to your lower chest, elbows tucked.
Press up until your elbows lock and breathe out.

exercises.name: Bench Press - Wide Grip (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A wider bench press, which shortens the range and loads the chest.
steps: Lie back so the bar sits over your forehead.
Grip wider than shoulder-width and pull your shoulder blades together.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your chest.
Breathe in and lower it to your nipple line.
Press up until your elbows lock and breathe out.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row (Barbell)
exercises.summary: The main horizontal pull. Flat back, bar to the stomach.
steps: Stand over the bar with feet hip-width, toes slightly out.
Hinge forward with a flat back and grip the bar overhand.
Lift the bar to arm's length and brace your abs.
Breathe in and row the bar to your stomach.
Hold a moment, breathe out, and lower under control.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Barbell)
exercises.summary: The main biceps builder. No swinging, just the arms.
steps: Hold the bar palms up, hands just wider than your hips.
Stand tall with your chest out and elbows at your sides.
Breathe in and curl the bar without swinging your body.
Breathe out at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Box Squat (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A squat to a box, which fixes your depth every rep.
steps: Set a box behind you and unrack the bar onto your upper back.
Step back so the box is just behind your heels.
Breathe in and sit back until you touch the box.
Pause, then push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A rear-foot-elevated split squat with the bar on your back.
steps: Rack the bar on your upper back and face away from a bench.
Place one foot back on the bench.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Bend your front knee until that thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to stand and breathe out.
Finish your reps, then swap legs.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.summary: The main hinge. The bar drags up your legs in a straight line.
steps: Stand with the bar over your mid-foot, feet hip-width.
Hinge down and grip the bar just outside your knees.
Drop your hips, lift your chest and brace hard.
Push the floor away and stand, keeping the bar against your legs.
Lock out your hips, then lower along the same path.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A press on a decline, which favours the lower chest.
steps: Hook your legs into a decline bench and lie back.
Grip the bar just wider than your shoulders and unrack it.
Breathe in and lower it to your lower chest.
Press up until your elbows lock and breathe out.

exercises.name: Feet Up Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A bench press with the feet up, which removes leg drive.
steps: Lie on the bench and lift your feet off the floor, knees bent.
Grip the bar just wider than your shoulders and unrack it.
Brace hard, breathe in and lower it to your lower chest.
Press up without rocking, and breathe out.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A press from the floor. The elbows stop before the shoulder strains.
steps: Lie on the floor under the bar with your knees bent.
Grip the bar just wider than your shoulders and unrack it.
Breathe in and lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause, then press up and breathe out.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A front-delt raise. Stop at shoulder height, no higher.
steps: Stand holding the bar at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Brace your abs and keep your arms almost straight.
Breathe out and raise the bar to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly and breathe in.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A floor version of the hip thrust, with a shorter range.
steps: Lie on the floor and roll the bar over your hips.
Bend your knees and plant your feet close to your hips.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips as high as they go.
Squeeze your glutes, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Good Morning (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A hinge with the bar on your back. Go light, the leverage is long.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and step into a hip-width stance.
Soften your knees and brace your abs.
Breathe in and push your hips back, folding your torso forward.
Stop at about parallel, then drive your hips forward to stand.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Barbell)
exercises.summary: The heaviest glute movement. Tuck your ribs so the back stays out of it.
steps: Sit with your upper back on a bench and roll the bar over your hips.
Plant your feet flat and tuck your ribs down.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips level with your knees.
Squeeze hard at the top, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A press on an incline, which shifts work to the upper chest.
steps: Set the bench to about thirty degrees and lie back.
Grip the bar just wider than your shoulders and pull your shoulder blades together.
Unrack the bar and hold it over your upper chest.
Breathe in and lower it to touch just below your collarbone.
Press up until your elbows lock and breathe out.

exercises.name: JM Press (Barbell)
exercises.summary: Half skullcrusher, half close-grip press. Keep the bar over your elbows.
steps: Lie on a bench and grip the bar at shoulder width.
Unrack it and hold it over your upper chest.
Breathe in and lower the bar toward your chin, tucking your elbows.
Press back up along the same path and breathe out.

exercises.name: Lunge (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A lunge with the bar on your back. Balance first, load second.
steps: Unrack the bar onto your upper back and step clear.
Step one foot forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nears the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Meadows Rows (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A one-arm row on a landmine. Stand side-on and pull to your hip.
steps: Wedge one end of the bar into a corner and stand side-on to it.
Hinge forward and grip the loaded end with your outside hand.
Breathe in and row the bar up to your hip.
Lower under control, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Barbell)
exercises.summary: The main overhead lift. Squeeze your glutes so you do not lean back.
steps: Set the bar on your front shoulders with hands just outside them.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Breathe in and press the bar straight up past your face.
Lock out overhead with the bar over your mid-foot, and breathe out.
Lower it back to your shoulders under control.

exercises.name: Partial Glute Bridge (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A short-range bridge that keeps the glutes under constant tension.
steps: Lie on the floor with the bar over your hips and knees bent.
Lift your hips to the top and squeeze.
Lower only halfway, then drive back up.
Keep the reps short and never rest your hips on the floor.

exercises.name: Pause Squat (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A squat with a dead stop at the bottom, which kills all bounce.
steps: Unrack the bar onto your upper back and step into your stance.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Squat to parallel and hold still for two full seconds.
Stay braced, then drive up through your heels and breathe out.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A row that resets on the floor each rep, so there is no swing.
steps: Stand over the bar and hinge until your torso is parallel to the floor.
Grip the bar overhand, just wider than your shoulders.
Breathe in and pull the bar explosively to your lower chest.
Lower it all the way to the floor and reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A curl on a pad, which stops the elbows drifting back.
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with your armpits over the top of the pad.
Hold the bar with palms up and arms almost straight.
Breathe out and curl the bar toward your chin.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A palms-down curl that builds the forearm as much as the arm.
steps: Hold the bar at your thighs with an overhand grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides and wrists straight.
Breathe out and curl the bar to chest height.
Lower it slowly and breathe in.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (Barbell)
exercises.summary: Stepping back rather than forward, which is kinder to the knees.
steps: Unrack the bar onto your upper back and set your feet hip-width.
Breathe in and step one foot back into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nears the floor.
Push through your front heel to return and breathe out.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A hinge with soft knees. Feel it in the hamstrings, not the back.
steps: Stand holding the bar at your thighs, feet hip-width.
Soften your knees and brace your abs.
Breathe in and push your hips back, lowering the bar down your legs.
Stop when your hamstrings stretch and your back is still flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Seal Row (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A chest-supported row. The bench removes every trace of cheating.
steps: Lie face down on a raised bench with the bar underneath.
Reach down and grip it just wider than your shoulders.
Breathe in and row the bar up to the bench.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Press (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A seated press, which takes the legs and back out of it.
steps: Sit on an upright bench with the bar at shoulder height.
Grip just outside your shoulders and brace your abs.
Breathe in and press the bar straight overhead.
Lock out, then lower to your shoulders and breathe out.

exercises.name: Seated Wrist Curl (Barbell)
exercises.summary: Forearm flexion. Let the bar roll to your fingertips for full range.
steps: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms facing up.
Let your wrists hang past your knees holding the bar.
Let the bar roll down to your fingers, then curl it back up.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Wrist Extension (Barbell)
exercises.summary: Forearm extension. Lighter than it looks, so start small.
steps: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms facing down.
Let your wrists hang past your knees holding the bar.
Lift the back of your hands toward you as far as they go.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Shrug (Barbell)
exercises.summary: Direct trap work. Shrug straight up, do not roll your shoulders.
steps: Stand holding the bar at your thighs with straight arms.
Brace your abs and keep your chin tucked.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears and breathe out.
Hold for a second, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Single Arm Landmine Press (Barbell)
exercises.summary: An angled press, gentler on the shoulder than pressing straight up.
steps: Wedge one end of the bar into a corner and hold the other at your shoulder.
Stand with feet staggered and brace your abs.
Breathe in, then press the bar up and away at an angle.
Lower it back to your shoulder, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A one-legged hinge. Keep both hips facing the floor.
steps: Hold the bar and stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Hinge forward, letting the free leg travel back as a counterweight.
Stop when your hamstring stretches, then drive your hips forward.
Finish your reps, then swap legs.

exercises.name: Single Leg Standing Calf Raise (Barbell)
exercises.summary: One calf at a time under load. Hold a rack for balance.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and stand on one foot.
Hook the other foot behind your ankle.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes and squeeze.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Skullcrusher (Barbell)
exercises.summary: Direct triceps work. The elbows stay pointed at the ceiling.
steps: Lie on a bench holding the bar over your chest, hands shoulder-width.
Keep your upper arms vertical and still.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your elbows to press it back up and breathe out.

exercises.name: Spider Curl (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A curl hanging over an incline bench, with tension from the very bottom.
steps: Lie face down on an incline bench with your arms hanging straight.
Hold the bar with palms up.
Breathe out and curl the bar up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Squat (Barbell)
exercises.summary: The main lower-body lift. Brace hard before every rep.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and grip it firmly.
Unrack it and step back into a shoulder-width stance, toes slightly out.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Sit down and back until your thighs reach parallel.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A loaded calf raise. Pause at the top, do not bounce.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and stand tall.
Place the balls of your feet on a step if you have one.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes and squeeze.
Lower slowly until you feel the stretch.

exercises.name: Standing Military Press (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A strict overhead press with feet together. No leg drive at all.
steps: Stand with your feet close and the bar on your front shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes and brace hard.
Breathe in and press the bar straight overhead without dipping.
Lock out, then lower to your shoulders and breathe out.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A wide-stance squat that shares the work with the inner thigh.
steps: Unrack the bar onto your upper back.
Step into a wide stance with your toes turned well out.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Sit straight down, keeping your knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Thruster (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A front squat straight into an overhead press. Do not pause between.
steps: Hold the bar on your front shoulders with elbows high.
Breathe in and squat until your thighs reach parallel.
Drive up and let the momentum carry the bar overhead.
Lock out, then bring it back to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Barbell)
exercises.summary: An overhead triceps stretch. Keep your ribs down, not flared.
steps: Sit or stand holding the bar overhead with straight arms.
Keep your elbows close to your head and brace your abs.
Breathe in and lower the bar behind your head.
Extend your elbows to press it back up and breathe out.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Barbell)
exercises.summary: A high pull to the chest. Stop at chest height to spare the shoulder.
steps: Stand holding the bar at your thighs, hands shoulder-width.
Brace your abs and keep the bar close to your body.
Breathe out and pull your elbows up and out to chest height.
Lower slowly and breathe in.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes
exercises.summary: Alternating rope waves. Keep the knees soft and the pace hard.
steps: Hold one rope in each hand and stand with knees soft.
Hinge forward slightly and keep your back flat.
Drive one arm up to shoulder height as the other drops.
Alternate fast and steady, breathing evenly.

exercises.name: Bear Crawl
exercises.summary: A crawl on hands and feet. Keep your hips low and knees off the floor.
steps: Start on hands and knees with hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and lift your knees an inch off the floor.
Step your right hand and left foot forward together.
Alternate sides and keep your hips low as you travel.

exercises.name: Bench Dip
exercises.summary: A triceps dip off a bench. Straighten your legs to make it harder.
steps: Sit on a bench edge and place your hands beside your hips.
Slide forward off the bench with your legs straight.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to ninety degrees.
Press back up until your arms are straight and breathe out.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch
exercises.summary: An alternating twist crunch. Turn from the ribs, not the neck.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet off the floor.
Rest your fingertips behind your head.
Breathe in, then crunch your right elbow toward your left knee.
Breathe out, switch sides, and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Bicycle Crunch Raised Legs
exercises.summary: The bicycle crunch with legs extended, which loads the lower abs too.
steps: Lie on your back and extend both legs into the air.
Rest your fingertips behind your head.
Breathe in, then crunch your right elbow toward your left knee.
Bend that knee in to meet the elbow, then switch sides.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.summary: A slow opposite-limb reach. The work is keeping your back still.
steps: Kneel on all fours, hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Reach your right arm forward and your left leg back.
Hold a moment, breathe out, and return.
Alternate sides for each rep.

exercises.name: Russian Twist (Bodyweight)
exercises.summary: A seated rotation. Turn from the ribs, not by swinging your arms.
steps: Sit with your knees bent and lean your torso back to about forty-five degrees.
Lift your feet a few inches off the floor and brace your abs.
Rotate your ribs to bring your hands beside one hip.
Rotate to the other side and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Squat (Bodyweight)
exercises.summary: The base squat pattern. Sit down between your hips, not backwards.
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width and toes turned slightly out.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Sit down and back until your thighs reach parallel.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.summary: An explosive jump onto a box. Step down, never jump down.
steps: Stand a short step in front of the box, feet close.
Breathe in and dip into a quarter squat, arms swinging back.
Jump up and land softly on the box with soft knees.
Step back down and reset.

exercises.name: Boxing
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Burpee
exercises.summary: A push-up into a jump. The classic whole-body conditioning rep.
steps: Stand tall, then squat and place your hands on the floor.
Kick your feet back into a push-up position.
Breathe in and lower your chest, then press back up.
Jump your feet back to your hands.
Stand and jump with your arms overhead, breathing out.

exercises.name: Burpee Broad Jumps
exercises.summary: A burpee that finishes with a long forward jump.
steps: Stand feet shoulder-width, then place your hands on the floor.
Kick your feet back and lower your chest to the floor.
Press up and jump your feet forward to your hands.
Stand and jump forward as far as you can, breathing out.

exercises.name: Burpee Over the Bar
exercises.summary: A burpee with a sideways jump over a barbell between reps.
steps: Stand beside a barbell and drop into a high plank.
Breathe in, lower your chest, and press back up.
Jump your feet forward and stand.
Jump sideways over the bar and breathe out.
Drop back down and repeat from the other side.

exercises.name: Behind the Back Curl (Cable)
exercises.summary: A curl with the elbow behind you, which loads the stretch.
steps: Set the pulley to mid-thigh and attach a handle.
Face away from the machine and step forward to load the cable.
Let the handle pull your elbow behind your body.
Breathe in and curl until your wrist reaches elbow height.
Squeeze, breathe out, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Cable)
exercises.summary: A bench press on cables, with tension right through lockout.
steps: Set a flat bench between two low pulleys and attach handles.
Sit, take a handle in each hand, then lie back.
Hold the handles at chest level with your elbows tucked.
Breathe in, then press up and in until your knuckles meet.
Lower until your elbows reach torso level and breathe out.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Cable)
exercises.summary: A curl with even tension from bottom to top.
steps: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and set the weight.
Grip it palms up and stand tall with elbows at your sides.
Breathe in and curl until your wrists pass your elbows.
Breathe out, then lower without letting your elbows drift.

exercises.name: Cable Core Pallof Press
exercises.summary: An anti-rotation press. The work is refusing to twist.
steps: Set the pulley at chest height and hold the handle in both hands.
Stand side-on and step out to load the cable.
Squeeze your glutes and brace hard against the pull.
Breathe in, press the handle straight out, and breathe out.
Pause, then bring it back to your chest.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.summary: A kneeling crunch against a cable. Curl the ribs, not the hips.
steps: Attach a rope to a high pulley and kneel facing the machine.
Hold the rope beside your head and brace your abs.
Breathe in, then crunch your ribs toward your hips.
Breathe out at the bottom, then rise slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Fly Crossovers
exercises.summary: A high-to-low cable fly, meeting your hands in front of your hips.
steps: Set both pulleys high and attach a handle to each.
Stand between them and step forward to load the weight.
Breathe in with your arms out to your sides, elbows soft.
Bring your hands down and together in front of your hips.
Breathe out, then open your arms slowly.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Cable)
exercises.summary: A front raise with constant tension from a low pulley.
steps: Set a low pulley behind you and grip the handle.
Stand tall with your arm down and braced abs.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly under control.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Cable)
exercises.summary: A neutral-grip cable curl using a rope.
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and grip both ends, palms in.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the rope up without turning your wrists.
Lower it slowly under control.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Cable)
exercises.summary: A standing cable abduction with an ankle strap.
steps: Strap a low pulley to your outside ankle and stand side-on.
Hold the frame for balance and brace your abs.
Lift that leg out to the side without leaning.
Return slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Cable)
exercises.summary: A standing cable adduction with an ankle strap.
steps: Strap a low pulley to your inside ankle and stand side-on.
Hold the frame for balance and brace your abs.
Pull that leg across your body past the midline.
Return slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.summary: The seated vertical pull. Pull to your collarbone, not behind your neck.
steps: Set the thigh pads and grip the bar wider than your shoulders.
Sit down and let your arms straighten fully.
Breathe in and pull the bar to your upper chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then let it rise slowly.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown - Close Grip (Cable)
exercises.summary: A narrow pulldown, which lengthens the range and works the arms more.
steps: Attach a close-grip handle and set the thigh pads.
Sit down and let your arms straighten fully.
Pull the handle to your upper chest, elbows tight to your sides.
Squeeze, then let it rise slowly.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Cable)
exercises.summary: A side raise with even tension from bottom to top.
steps: Set a low pulley and grip the handle with the far hand.
Stand side-on with the cable across your body.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Overhead Curl (Cable)
exercises.summary: A curl with the arm out to the side, which peaks the biceps.
steps: Set a pulley above shoulder height and grip the handle palm up.
Stand side-on with your arm straight out to the side.
Curl your hand toward your head without dropping your elbow.
Straighten your arm slowly, then swap sides.

exercises.name: Overhead Triceps Extension (Cable)
exercises.summary: An overhead extension on a cable, which keeps the stretch loaded.
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and face away from the machine.
Hold the rope behind your head with your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your elbows to press the rope overhead.
Lower it slowly behind your head.

exercises.name: Cable Pull Through
exercises.summary: A hinge with the cable between your legs. Pure hip movement.
steps: Set a rope on a low pulley and face away, straddling the cable.
Hold the rope between your legs and step forward.
Push your hips back until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Drive your hips forward and squeeze your glutes.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Cable)
exercises.summary: A cable rear-delt fly. Cross the cables and sweep wide.
steps: Set both pulleys at shoulder height and cross-grab the handles.
Stand tall with your arms out in front, elbows soft.
Sweep your arms out and back to your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Cable)
exercises.summary: A palms-down cable curl that builds the top of the forearm.
steps: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and grip it overhand.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up to chest height with your wrists straight.
Lower it slowly under control.

exercises.name: Reverse Fly Single Arm (Cable)
exercises.summary: A one-arm rear-delt sweep, which lets you feel the muscle work.
steps: Set a low pulley and grip the handle with the opposite hand.
Stand side-on with a soft elbow and your arm across your body.
Sweep your arm out and back to your side.
Return slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.summary: An underhand pulldown, which puts the biceps to work.
steps: Grip the bar shoulder-width with your palms facing you.
Sit down under the pads and let your arms straighten.
Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows driving down.
Squeeze, then let it rise slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row - V Grip (Cable)
exercises.summary: The classic cable row with a neutral V handle.
steps: Sit with your feet on the plate and grip the V handle.
Sit tall with a flat back and straight arms.
Pull the handle to your stomach, elbows tight to your sides.
Squeeze, then let your arms straighten slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Chest Flys (Cable)
exercises.summary: A seated cable fly, which keeps tension even across the range.
steps: Set a bench between two pulleys at chest height.
Sit and grip a handle in each hand with soft elbows.
Bring your hands together in front of your chest.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: Shrug (Cable)
exercises.summary: A trap shrug with constant cable tension.
steps: Stand facing away from a low pulley holding the bar at your thighs.
Keep your arms straight and your chin tucked.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Single Arm Curl (Cable)
exercises.summary: A one-arm cable curl, with tension right through the bottom.
steps: Attach a handle to a low pulley and grip it palm up.
Stand tall with your elbow pinned to your side.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and swap arms.

exercises.name: Single Arm Lateral Raise (Cable)
exercises.summary: A one-arm cable raise, easiest place to feel the side delt.
steps: Set a low pulley and grip the handle with the far hand.
Stand side-on and brace your abs.
Raise your arm out to the side to shoulder height.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Single Arm Triceps Pushdown (Cable)
exercises.summary: A one-arm pushdown, which stops the stronger side taking over.
steps: Grip a single handle on a high pulley with your palm down.
Pin that elbow to your side and stand tall.
Push the handle down until your arm is straight.
Let it rise slowly, then swap arms.

exercises.name: Standing Y Raise (Cable)
exercises.summary: A raise into a Y, which catches the lower traps. Go light.
steps: Set two low pulleys and cross-grab a handle in each hand.
Stand tall with your arms down and crossed.
Raise both arms up and out into a Y above your head.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Straight Arm Lat Pulldown (Cable)
exercises.summary: A lat isolation with straight arms. No elbow bend at all.
steps: Stand facing a high pulley and grip the bar with straight arms.
Hinge slightly forward and brace your abs.
Push the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Let it rise slowly, keeping your elbows straight.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Cable)
exercises.summary: A cable extension. Keep the upper arms locked in place.
steps: Attach a rope or bar to a pulley and grip it.
Fix your upper arms and brace your abs.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight.
Bend them slowly back to the start.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback (Cable)
exercises.summary: A cable kickback, which holds tension at full extension.
steps: Grip a low-pulley handle and hinge forward with a flat back.
Pin your upper arm to your side, parallel to the floor.
Extend your elbow to straighten your arm behind you.
Bend it slowly, finish your reps and swap arms.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Cable)
exercises.summary: A cable high pull. Stop at chest height to spare the shoulder.
steps: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and grip it overhand.
Stand tall with the bar at your thighs.
Pull your elbows up and out to chest height.
Lower it slowly under control.

exercises.name: Chest Dip
exercises.summary: A dip leaning forward, which puts the chest in charge.
steps: Grip the parallel bars and press up to straight arms.
Lean your torso forward and let your elbows flare slightly.
Breathe in and lower until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Press back up to straight arms and breathe out.

exercises.name: Chest Supported T Bar Row
exercises.summary: A T bar row with a chest pad, which removes all cheating.
steps: Set the pad height and lie chest-down on the machine.
Grip the handles and let your arms hang straight.
Pull the handles up until your elbows pass your torso.
Squeeze, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Chin Up
exercises.summary: An underhand pull-up, which gives the biceps more of the work.
steps: Grip the bar shoulder-width with your palms facing you.
Hang with straight arms and pull your shoulders down.
Breathe in and pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower yourself slowly and breathe out.

exercises.name: Clamshell
exercises.summary: A side-lying hip rotation with a band above the knees.
steps: Lie on your side with a band above your knees and hips stacked.
Bend your knees to about ninety degrees.
Keeping your feet together, lift your top knee against the band.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Clap Push Ups
exercises.summary: An explosive push-up. Land with soft elbows, never locked.
steps: Set your hands just wider than your shoulders, body straight.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward the floor.
Drive up hard enough that your hands leave the ground.
Clap, then land with bent elbows and absorb the landing.

exercises.name: Clean
exercises.summary: Floor to shoulders in one movement. Learn it light with a coach.
steps: Set up over the bar as for a deadlift.
Lift the bar past your knees, keeping it close to your legs.
Extend your hips and shrug hard, then pull yourself under the bar.
Catch it on your front shoulders in a squat and stand up.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk
exercises.summary: A clean then an overhead jerk. The most technical lift here.
steps: Clean the bar from the floor to your front shoulders.
Dip by bending your knees a few inches.
Drive up hard and punch the bar overhead as you split your feet.
Recover your feet, then lower the bar under control.

exercises.name: Clean and Press
exercises.summary: A clean followed by a strict overhead press.
steps: Clean the bar from the floor to your front shoulders.
Stand tall, squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press the bar overhead without dipping your knees.
Lower it to your shoulders, then to the floor.

exercises.name: Clean Pull
exercises.summary: The pull half of a clean, without the catch.
steps: Set up over the bar as for a deadlift.
Pull the bar past your knees, keeping it close to your legs.
Extend your hips and shrug hard so the bar rises to your chest.
Lower it under control and reset.

exercises.name: Climbing
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Concentration Curl
exercises.summary: A seated single-arm curl with the elbow braced on your thigh.
steps: Sit with your legs apart and a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace that elbow against the inside of your thigh.
Curl the weight up toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly, finish your reps and swap arms.

exercises.name: Cross Body Hammer Curl
exercises.summary: A hammer curl across the body, which loads the brachialis.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Curl one weight across your body toward the opposite shoulder.
Lower it slowly, then curl the other arm across.
Keep your elbows pinned to your sides.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.summary: A short-range ab curl. Lift the shoulder blades, not the whole back.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat.
Rest your fingertips behind your head without pulling on it.
Breathe out and curl your shoulder blades off the floor.
Pause, then lower slowly and breathe in.

exercises.name: Cycling
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.summary: A core drill that teaches your back to stay flat while limbs move.
steps: Lie on your back with arms up and knees bent over your hips.
Press your lower back flat into the floor.
Lower your right arm and left leg until they hover above the floor.
Return them and repeat with the other pair, keeping your back flat.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.summary: A grip and shoulder hold. Stay active, do not sag into the joints.
steps: Grip the bar just wider than your shoulders, palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and your feet clear of the floor.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears.
Hold and breathe steadily until your grip gives out.

exercises.name: Deadlift High Pull
exercises.summary: A deadlift that finishes with a pull to the chest. Lead with the elbows.
steps: Set up as for a deadlift with the bar over your mid-foot.
Drive the floor away and stand explosively.
As the bar passes your hips, pull your elbows high and wide.
Bring the bar to chest height, then lower it under control.

exercises.name: Decline Crunch
exercises.summary: A crunch on a decline, which loads the abs from the very bottom.
steps: Hook your legs over a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms on your chest and brace your abs.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders up toward your knees.
Lower slowly until your back touches the bench and breathe in.

exercises.name: Decline Push Up
exercises.summary: A push-up with your feet raised, which shifts load to the shoulders.
steps: Place your feet on a bench and hands just wider than your shoulders.
Straighten your body and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up and breathe out.

exercises.name: Diamond Push Up
exercises.summary: The hardest bodyweight triceps press. Keep the elbows in.
steps: Set your hands together under your chest, thumbs and fingers touching.
Straighten your body and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe in and lower your chest to your hands, elbows tucked.
Press back up and breathe out.

exercises.name: Cable Twist (Down to up)
exercises.summary: A diagonal chop upward. Pivot your feet, do not twist your knees.
steps: Set a low pulley and grip the handle with both hands.
Stand side-on with the handle beside your outside hip.
Sweep it diagonally up and across to above your far shoulder.
Return slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
exercises.summary: A whole-back-line stretch. Bend your knees to get a long spine.
steps: Start on all fours with hands slightly ahead of your shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your hips up and back.
Push the floor away and let your head hang between your arms.
Bend your knees as much as you need and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Drag Curl
exercises.summary: A curl that drags the bar up your body, keeping tension on the biceps.
steps: Stand holding the bar at your thighs with palms up.
Let your elbows travel back as you lift.
Drag the bar straight up your torso to chest height.
Lower it along the same path under control.

exercises.name: Dragon Flag
exercises.summary: An advanced lowering movement. Bend your knees to scale it down.
steps: Lie on a bench and grip it firmly behind your head.
Drive your legs up until your weight rests on your upper back.
Lower your straight body as one unit, as slowly as you can.
Stop before your hips touch and drive back up.

exercises.name: Dragonfly
exercises.summary: The dragon flag done for reps. Keep your hips and ribs locked together.
steps: Lie on a bench and grip it firmly behind your head.
Lift your legs and hips until only your shoulders stay down.
Lower your body in one straight line under control.
Stop just short of the bench and lift again.

exercises.name: Arnold Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: An overhead press with a rotation, which sweeps the whole shoulder.
steps: Sit upright with the dumbbells at your chin, palms facing you.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Press overhead, rotating your palms to face forward.
Breathe out at the top.
Lower slowly, rotating your palms back toward you.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A bench press with dumbbells, which lets each arm find its own path.
steps: Sit on a flat bench with a dumbbell on each thigh.
Kick the dumbbells up as you lie back.
Hold them over your chest with your shoulder blades pinned.
Breathe in and lower until your elbows reach torso level.
Press up and together, and breathe out.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A two-dumbbell row. Hinge until your torso is near parallel.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand tall.
Hinge forward with a flat back until your torso is near parallel.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Breathe in and row until your elbows pass your torso.
Breathe out at the top and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: The base biceps curl, one dumbbell in each hand.
steps: Stand tall with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Set your shoulders back and keep your elbows at your sides.
Breathe in and curl until your wrists pass your elbows.
Breathe out at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A rear-foot-elevated split squat holding dumbbells.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and face away from a bench.
Place one foot back on the bench.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Bend your front knee until that thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to stand and breathe out.
Finish your reps, then swap legs.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A wide arc that stretches the chest. Keep a soft bend in the elbows.
steps: Lie on a flat bench holding a dumbbell over each shoulder.
Soften your elbows and keep that angle fixed.
Breathe in and open your arms wide until your chest stretches.
Squeeze your chest to bring them back together and breathe out.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Incline Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A row with your chest on an incline bench, so the back does all of it.
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight toward the floor.
Breathe in and row both dumbbells until your elbows pass your torso.
Squeeze, then lower slowly and breathe out.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Reverse Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A rear-delt fly with your chest supported. Go light and slow.
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise both weights out to your sides until level with your shoulders.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Chest Supported Y Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A raise in a Y shape, which hits the lower traps. Very light weights.
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down with thumbs up.
Raise both arms forward and out into a Y above your head.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Curtsy Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A crossing lunge that catches the side of the glute.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with feet hip-width.
Step one foot back and across behind the other.
Bend both knees until your back knee nears the floor.
Push through your front heel to return, then swap sides.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A hinge with dumbbells, which suits a home setup with no bar.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and brace your abs.
Breathe in and push your hips back, lowering the weights down your legs.
Drive your hips forward to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A dumbbell press on a decline, aimed at the lower chest.
steps: Hook your legs into a decline bench and lie back with the dumbbells.
Hold them over your lower chest with shoulder blades pinned.
Breathe in and lower until your elbows reach torso level.
Press up and together, and breathe out.

exercises.name: Decline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A fly on a decline, which biases the lower chest.
steps: Hook your legs into a decline bench and hold a dumbbell over each shoulder.
Soften your elbows and keep that angle fixed.
Breathe in and open your arms wide until your chest stretches.
Bring them back together and breathe out.

exercises.name: Floor Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A press from the floor. The elbows stop before the shoulder strains.
steps: Lie on the floor with a dumbbell in each hand and knees bent.
Hold the weights over your chest with your elbows tucked.
Breathe in and lower until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause, then press up and breathe out.

exercises.name: Frog Pumps (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A short-range glute pump with the soles of the feet together.
steps: Lie on your back with a dumbbell on your hips.
Put the soles of your feet together and let your knees fall open.
Drive your hips up and squeeze your glutes hard.
Lower part way and pump again without resting.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A front-delt raise. Stop at shoulder height, no higher.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Brace your abs and keep your arms almost straight.
Raise one or both weights forward to shoulder height.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A neutral-grip curl that builds the arm's thickness.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing each other.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl both weights up without turning your wrists.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Hex Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A squeeze press with flat-sided dumbbells touching throughout.
steps: Lie on a bench with two hex dumbbells pressed flat together.
Hold them over your chest with your elbows tucked in.
Breathe in and lower them to touch your chest.
Press up without letting them separate, and breathe out.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A thrust with a dumbbell across the hips. Tuck your ribs down.
steps: Sit with your upper back on a bench and a dumbbell across your hips.
Plant your feet flat and hold the weight steady.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips level with your knees.
Squeeze at the top, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A dumbbell press on an incline, aimed at the upper chest.
steps: Set the bench to about thirty degrees and sit with the dumbbells on your thighs.
Kick them up as you lie back and pin your shoulder blades.
Breathe in and lower until your elbows reach torso level.
Press up and together, and breathe out.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A fly on an incline, which biases the upper chest.
steps: Set the bench to about thirty degrees and hold a dumbbell over each shoulder.
Soften your elbows and keep that angle fixed.
Breathe in and open your arms wide until your chest stretches.
Bring them back together over your chest and breathe out.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A side raise for the middle delt. Lead with the elbow, not the hand.
steps: Stand holding a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Soften your elbows and brace your abs.
Raise both arms out to the sides until level with your shoulders.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A forward lunge with dumbbells. Drop straight down, not forward.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one foot forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nears the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A standing overhead press. Brace so the load does not hit your back.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell at each shoulder, palms forward.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Breathe in and press both weights straight overhead.
Lower them under control and breathe out.

exercises.name: Pinwheel Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A cross-body hammer curl finishing at the opposite shoulder.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Curl one weight across your chest to the opposite shoulder.
Lower it slowly under control.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A curl over a pad, so the elbows cannot drift back.
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with one arm over the pad.
Hold a dumbbell with your palm up and arm nearly straight.
Curl the weight toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and swap arms.

exercises.name: Pullover (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: An overhead stretch for the lats. Keep your ribs down.
steps: Lie on a bench holding one dumbbell over your chest with both hands.
Soften your elbows and brace your abs.
Breathe in and lower the weight in an arc behind your head.
Pull it back over your chest and breathe out.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A bent-over rear-delt fly. Lead with the elbows, not the hands.
steps: Hinge forward with a dumbbell in each hand, back flat.
Let your arms hang with a soft bend in the elbows.
Raise both weights out to your sides to shoulder height.
Squeeze, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Renegade Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A plank plus a row. Widen your feet to stop your hips rocking.
steps: Start in a high plank gripping a dumbbell in each hand.
Set your feet wide and brace your abs hard.
Row one dumbbell to your hip without letting your hips turn.
Lower it and row the other side.

exercises.name: Reverse Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A palms-down curl that builds the top of the forearm.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing back.
Keep your elbows at your sides and wrists straight.
Curl both weights to chest height.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: Stepping back rather than forward, which is easier on the knees.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand with feet hip-width.
Breathe in and step one foot back into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nears the floor.
Push through your front heel to return and breathe out.

exercises.name: Reverse Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: Forearm extension. Much lighter than the palms-up version.
steps: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms down.
Let your wrists hang past your knees holding the dumbbells.
Lift the backs of your hands toward you as far as they go.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A hinge with soft knees. The stretch should be in the hamstrings.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Soften your knees and brace your abs.
Breathe in and push your hips back, keeping the weights close.
Stop when your hamstrings stretch, then drive your hips forward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Row
exercises.summary: A one-arm row. Pull to the hip, not the shoulder.
steps: Put one knee and hand on a bench with a dumbbell in the other hand.
Keep your back flat and your shoulders square.
Breathe in and row the dumbbell up to your hip.
Lower it slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Seal Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A chest-supported row. The bench removes any chance of swinging.
steps: Lie face down on a raised bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Breathe in and row both dumbbells up to the bench.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Incline Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A curl with the arms behind you, which stretches the biceps hard.
steps: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down behind your torso.
Curl both weights up without moving your elbows forward.
Lower them slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Incline Hammer Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: The incline curl with a neutral grip. Same stretch, more forearm.
steps: Sit back on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang with palms facing each other.
Curl both weights up without turning your wrists.
Lower them slowly to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Seated Lateral Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A seated side raise, which stops you swinging the weight up.
steps: Sit upright on a bench with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Soften your elbows and keep your torso still.
Raise both arms out to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Seated Overhead Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A seated press, which takes the legs and lower back out of it.
steps: Sit on an upright bench with a dumbbell at each shoulder.
Press your back into the pad and brace your abs.
Breathe in and press both weights overhead.
Lower them to your shoulders and breathe out.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A seated or standing overhead press. Do not let your ribs flare.
steps: Hold a dumbbell at each shoulder with palms facing forward.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe in and press both weights overhead until your elbows lock.
Lower them back to your shoulders and breathe out.

exercises.name: Shrug (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: Direct trap work. Straight up and down, never rolling.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your arms straight and your chin tucked.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Side Bend (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A loaded side bend. Hold weight in one hand only.
steps: Stand tall holding one dumbbell at your side.
Put your free hand behind your head and keep your hips square.
Bend sideways toward the weight, then pull back up.
Finish your reps, then swap sides.

exercises.name: Single Arm Tricep Extension (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A one-arm overhead extension. Hold your elbow to keep it still.
steps: Hold a dumbbell overhead in one hand with the elbow locked.
Support that elbow with your free hand.
Lower the weight behind your head under control.
Extend your elbow to press it up, then swap arms.

exercises.name: Single Leg Hip Thrust (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A one-legged thrust. Keep your hips square as you lift.
steps: Rest your upper back on a bench with a dumbbell on one hip.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg clear.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Squeeze at the top, lower slowly and swap legs.

exercises.name: Single Leg Romanian Deadlift (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A one-legged hinge. Keep both hips pointing at the floor.
steps: Hold a dumbbell and stand on one leg with a soft knee.
Brace your abs and hinge forward, letting the free leg swing back.
Stop when your hamstring stretches and your back is flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand, then swap legs.

exercises.name: Single Leg Standing Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: One calf at a time with a dumbbell. Hold something for balance.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in one hand and stand on that side's foot.
Steady yourself on a rail with your free hand.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes and squeeze.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Skullcrusher (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: Lying triceps extension. Upper arms stay vertical throughout.
steps: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell over each shoulder, palms in.
Keep your upper arms vertical and still.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower the weights beside your head.
Extend your elbows to press up and breathe out.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Snatch
exercises.summary: Floor to overhead with one arm. Drive with the hips, not the arm.
steps: Stand over a dumbbell with feet hip-width and grip it with one hand.
Brace your abs and drive the floor away explosively.
As it passes your hips, pull under and punch it overhead.
Lock out, lower it under control, then swap arms.

exercises.name: Spider Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A curl hanging over an incline bench, loaded from the very bottom.
steps: Lie chest-down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight with palms forward.
Curl both weights up to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Split Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A stationary lunge. Both feet stay planted throughout the set.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step into a long stride.
Keep both feet planted for the whole set.
Breathe in and bend both knees until your back knee nears the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand, then swap legs after your reps.

exercises.name: Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A squat with a dumbbell in each hand, hanging at your sides.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Breathe in and squat until your thighs reach parallel.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Squeeze Press
exercises.summary: A press with the dumbbells pushed together, for constant chest tension.
steps: Lie on a bench holding two dumbbells pressed together over your chest.
Keep squeezing them into each other the whole set.
Breathe in and lower them to your chest.
Press up while still squeezing, and breathe out.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A calf raise holding dumbbells. Use a step for more range.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, balls of your feet on a step.
Let your heels drop to a stretch.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes and squeeze.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Step Up
exercises.summary: Stepping onto a box. Drive with the top leg, do not push off the floor.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and stand facing a box or bench.
Place one whole foot on top of it.
Drive through that heel to stand up on the box.
Step down under control, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Suitcase Carry (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A one-sided carry. The work is not tipping over.
steps: Hold one heavy dumbbell at your side like a suitcase.
Stand tall with your shoulders level and abs braced.
Walk in a straight line without leaning away from the weight.
Swap hands and walk back.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A wide squat holding one dumbbell between your legs.
steps: Hold one dumbbell with both hands, hanging between your legs.
Stand with your feet wide and toes turned well out.
Breathe in and squat straight down.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: An overhead triceps stretch. Keep your elbows pointing forward.
steps: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands, arms straight.
Brace your abs so your ribs do not flare.
Breathe in and lower the weight behind your head.
Extend your elbows to press it up and breathe out.

exercises.name: Triceps Kickback (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A short-range triceps squeeze. The upper arm never moves.
steps: Hinge forward with a dumbbell in one hand and your elbow at your side.
Keep your upper arm parallel to the floor and still.
Extend your elbow to straighten your arm behind you.
Squeeze, lower slowly, then swap arms.

exercises.name: Upright Row (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A high pull with dumbbells. Stop at chest height for the shoulders' sake.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep the weights close to your body.
Pull your elbows up and out until your hands reach chest height.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Waiter Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A curl holding one dumbbell flat, like a tray. Keeps tension high.
steps: Hold one dumbbell upright in both palms, like carrying a tray.
Keep your elbows at your sides and stand tall.
Curl the weight up toward your chin.
Lower it slowly under control.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: Lunges travelling forward. Keep your torso tall the whole way.
steps: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and step forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nears the floor.
Drive through your front heel and step the back foot through.
Keep alternating and travelling forward.

exercises.name: Wide-Elbow Triceps Press (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: A lying press with the elbows flared, which loads the triceps' long head.
steps: Lie on a bench holding a dumbbell over each shoulder.
Let your elbows flare out to about forty-five degrees.
Breathe in and lower the weights toward your forehead.
Press them back up and breathe out.

exercises.name: Zottman Curl (Dumbbell)
exercises.summary: Curl up palms-up, lower palms-down. One rep trains both sides.
steps: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms up.
Curl both weights to your shoulders.
Turn your palms to face down at the top.
Lower slowly with palms down, then turn them back up.

exercises.name: Elbow to Knee
exercises.summary: A crunch with a twist. Turn from the ribs, not the neck.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and fingertips behind your head.
Breathe out and curl up, turning your right elbow to your left knee.
Lower and breathe in.
Repeat to the other side and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Elliptical Trainer
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: EZ Bar Biceps Curl
exercises.summary: A curl on an angled bar, which is easier on the wrists.
steps: Hold the EZ bar on the inner slopes with palms up.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Breathe in and curl the bar without swinging.
Breathe out at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.summary: A rear-delt pull to the face. Light weight, high elbows.
steps: Set a rope at face height and grip both ends with thumbs back.
Step back to load the cable and brace your abs.
Pull the rope to your face, elbows high and wide.
Squeeze, then let it out slowly.

exercises.name: Farmers Walk
exercises.summary: A loaded carry. Stand tall and walk, that is the whole exercise.
steps: Pick up a heavy weight in each hand with a flat back.
Stand tall with your shoulders back and abs braced.
Walk in a straight line with short, quick steps.
Set the weights down under control when your grip goes.

exercises.name: Fire Hydrants
exercises.summary: An outward hip lift. Keep your torso still as the knee rises.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your abs and keep your back flat.
Lift one knee out to the side, keeping it bent.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Floor Triceps Dip
exercises.summary: A dip done from the floor, so the range is short and safe.
steps: Sit with your knees bent and hands flat behind your hips.
Press into your hands to lift your hips off the floor.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to lower your hips.
Press back up until your arms are straight and breathe out.

exercises.name: Stair Machine (Floors)
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Flutter Kicks
exercises.summary: A low, constant hold for the lower abs. Keep your back pinned.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands under your hips.
Lift both legs a few inches off the floor.
Press your lower back down and kick your legs alternately.
Keep the kicks small and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Frog Jumps
exercises.summary: A deep squat into a jump. Reset your stance each rep.
steps: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders, toes out.
Squat deep and touch the floor between your feet.
Jump up and forward, swinging your arms.
Land softly back into the deep squat and repeat.

exercises.name: Front Lever Hold
exercises.summary: An advanced hanging hold. Tuck your knees to scale it down.
steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms and a hard brace.
Pull the bar toward your hips to raise your body.
Lift until your body is horizontal and facing up.
Hold your body in one line and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Front Lever Raise
exercises.summary: The moving version of the front lever. Keep the arms straight.
steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms and brace hard.
Pull the bar toward your hips to raise your body.
Lift until your body is horizontal, then lower under control.
Keep your arms straight the whole way.

exercises.name: Front Squat
exercises.summary: A squat with the bar in front, which keeps the torso upright.
steps: Rest the bar across your front shoulders and raise your elbows high.
Unrack it and step back into a shoulder-width stance.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Sit straight down, keeping your elbows up and chest tall.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Full Squat
exercises.summary: A squat taken to full depth. Only go as low as you can stay braced.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and unrack it.
Step back into a shoulder-width stance, toes slightly out.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Sit down as deep as you can without your lower back rounding.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Sternum Pull up (Gironda)
exercises.summary: A pull-up that leans back so the bar meets your sternum.
steps: Grip the bar and hang with straight arms.
Pull while leaning your head and torso back.
Keep pulling until the bar touches your lower chest.
Lower yourself slowly under control.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.summary: The base glute movement. Finish with the hips, not the lower back.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, close to your hips.
Squeeze your glutes and breathe in.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips into a straight line.
Squeeze at the top, breathe out, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Glute Ham Raise
exercises.summary: A hamstring curl using your own weight. Very hard, so go slow.
steps: Set your feet under the rollers and your thighs on the pad.
Start upright with your body in a straight line.
Lower your torso forward as slowly as you can control.
Curl yourself back up using your hamstrings.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback on Floor
exercises.summary: A direct glute movement. Stop when your lower back wants to arch.
steps: Start on all fours with hands under shoulders and knees under hips.
Brace your abs so your back stays flat.
Drive one heel back and up until your thigh lines up with your torso.
Squeeze, lower slowly, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.summary: A squat holding one weight at your chest, which keeps you upright.
steps: Hold one dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Breathe in and squat until your elbows pass the inside of your knees.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.summary: A squat with the bar behind your legs. Keep it close to your calves.
steps: Stand in front of a loaded bar with your heels close to it.
Squat and grip the bar behind you with an overhand grip.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Drive through your heels to stand, keeping the bar against your legs.
Lower it back to the floor under control.

exercises.name: Handstand Hold
exercises.summary: An overhead hold. Push the floor away and stack ribs over hips.
steps: Face a wall and kick up so your heels rest against it.
Set your hands shoulder-width with straight arms.
Squeeze your glutes and abs so your body forms one line.
Push the floor away through your shoulders and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Handstand Push Up
exercises.summary: The hardest bodyweight overhead press. Learn the hold first.
steps: Kick up into a handstand with your heels resting on a wall.
Set your hands shoulder-width and squeeze your glutes.
Breathe in and lower until the crown of your head nears the floor.
Press back up to straight arms and breathe out.

exercises.name: Hang Clean
exercises.summary: A clean starting from your thighs, which drills the second pull.
steps: Stand holding the bar at your thighs with a shoulder-width grip.
Hinge until the bar reaches just above your knees.
Extend your hips explosively and shrug.
Drop under and catch the bar on your front shoulders.

exercises.name: Hang Snatch
exercises.summary: A snatch from the thighs, which drills the explosive extension.
steps: Stand holding the bar at your thighs with a wide grip.
Hinge until the bar reaches just above your knees.
Extend your hips explosively and shrug.
Pull under and catch the bar overhead with locked arms.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.summary: A hanging core movement. Curl the hips, do not just lift the knees.
steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms and shoulders pulled down.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Curl your knees up toward your chest, tilting your hips.
Lower under control and breathe out.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.summary: The straight-leg version. Stop where your back starts to arch.
steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms and shoulders pulled down.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Raise your straight legs until they reach hip height or above.
Lower slowly without swinging, and breathe out.

exercises.name: Heel Taps
exercises.summary: A side-to-side reach for the obliques. Stay curled up throughout.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat, close to your hips.
Curl your shoulder blades a few inches off the floor.
Reach right and tap your right heel with your right hand.
Reach left and tap the other heel, keeping your shoulders up.

exercises.name: High Knee Skips
exercises.summary: A skipping drive for the hips. Aim for height, not speed.
steps: Stand tall and skip forward, driving one knee up hard.
Swing the opposite arm as the knee rises.
Land softly on the ball of your foot.
Alternate legs and keep the rhythm steady.

exercises.name: High Knees
exercises.summary: Running on the spot with the knees high. Stay on the balls of your feet.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width.
Run on the spot, driving each knee up to hip height.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms and keep the pace quick.

exercises.name: HIIT
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Hiking
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.summary: A bridge with your back raised, which lengthens the glute's range.
steps: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench.
Plant your feet flat, knees bent, and tuck your ribs down.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips level with your knees.
Squeeze hard at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Hollow Rock
exercises.summary: A rocking hold. If your back lifts, tuck your knees in.
steps: Lie on your back and lift your arms, head and legs off the floor.
Press your lower back into the floor to make a shallow dish.
Rock gently back and forth without changing your shape.
Breathe steadily and stop when your back starts to arch.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Hyperextension)
exercises.summary: A hip hinge on a 45-degree pad. Squeeze the glutes, do not crank the back.
steps: Set the pad at your hips and lock your ankles under the brace.
Cross your arms on your chest and brace your abs.
Breathe in and bend at the hips until your hamstrings stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to lift your torso in line with your legs.
Pause at the top and breathe out.

exercises.name: Incline Push Ups
exercises.summary: A push-up with your hands raised, which takes weight off the arms.
steps: Place your hands on a bench or step, just wider than your shoulders.
Walk your feet back until your body is straight.
Breathe in and lower your chest to the bench.
Press back up and breathe out.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.summary: A body-weight row under a fixed bar. Raise the bar to make it easier.
steps: Set a bar at hip height and lie underneath it.
Grip it just wider than your shoulders and hang with a straight body.
Pull your chest to the bar, keeping your hips up.
Lower yourself slowly under control.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Low Row
exercises.summary: A low row where each side is loaded separately.
steps: Sit with your chest on the pad and grip the low handles.
Let your arms straighten fully.
Pull the handles back toward your hips.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then let them out slowly.

exercises.name: Jackknife Sit Up
exercises.summary: Both halves move at once, so the abs work from top and bottom.
steps: Lie flat with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Breathe out and lift your arms and legs to meet above your hips.
Touch your hands to your feet at the top.
Lower both slowly and breathe in.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Jump Shrug
exercises.summary: An explosive shrug that leaves the floor. Land softly.
steps: Hold the bar at your thighs with a hip-width stance.
Dip slightly by bending your knees.
Drive up explosively, shrugging hard as your feet leave the floor.
Land softly with soft knees and reset.

exercises.name: Jump Squat
exercises.summary: An explosive squat. Absorb the landing with bent knees.
steps: Stand with your feet shoulder-width and brace your abs.
Breathe in and squat to about halfway down.
Jump straight up, driving through your heels.
Land softly, sink into the next squat and repeat.

exercises.name: Jumping Jack
exercises.summary: A whole-body warm-up. Land softly with a slight knee bend.
steps: Stand tall with your feet together and arms at your sides.
Jump your feet wide as you sweep your arms overhead.
Jump them back together and bring your arms down.
Keep a steady rhythm and breathe evenly.

exercises.name: Jumping Lunge
exercises.summary: An explosive lunge. Land softly with a bent front knee.
