steps: Start in a lunge with both knees bent.
Breathe in, then jump up and swap your legs in the air.
Land softly in a lunge with the other foot forward.
Keep alternating without pausing.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Around the World
exercises.summary: Passing the bell around your waist. Keep your hips still.
steps: Hold the bell in one hand at your side and stand tall.
Pass it behind your back to your other hand.
Bring it round the front to where you started.
Complete your reps, then circle the other way.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Clean
exercises.summary: Floor to rack in one move. Guide the bell round, do not let it bang.
steps: Hinge and hike the bell back between your legs.
Snap your hips and pull the bell up close to your body.
Rotate your hand round the handle as it comes up.
Catch it in the rack position against your forearm.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Curl
exercises.summary: A curl with the bell hanging below the handle, which loads the top.
steps: Hold the bell by the handle with your palm up.
Keep your elbow at your side and stand tall.
Curl the bell up toward your shoulder.
Lower it slowly under control.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat
exercises.summary: A squat holding the bell at your chest, which keeps you upright.
steps: Hold the bell by its horns against your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width, toes slightly out.
Breathe in and squat until your elbows pass inside your knees.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Gorilla Row (Kettlebell)
exercises.summary: An alternating row from the floor. The other bell keeps you steady.
steps: Stand over two bells with feet wide and hinge forward.
Grip both handles and keep your back flat.
Row one bell to your hip while the other stays on the floor.
Lower it and row the other side.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Halo
exercises.summary: A shoulder mobility circle. Slow and small before big.
steps: Hold the bell upside down by the horns at chest height.
Brace your abs and keep your ribs down.
Circle the bell around your head, close to it.
Complete the circle, then reverse direction.

exercises.name: Kettlebell High Pull
exercises.summary: A swing that finishes with an elbow pull. Keep the bell close.
steps: Hike the bell back between your legs and snap your hips.
As it rises, pull your elbow back and high.
Let the bell come to chest height close to your body.
Guide it back down into the next swing.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Shoulder Press
exercises.summary: An overhead press from the rack position. Brace before you press.
steps: Clean the bell to the rack position against your forearm.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs.
Press it overhead until your elbow locks.
Lower it back to the rack and repeat.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Snatch
exercises.summary: Floor to overhead in one pull. Punch through, do not let it flip.
steps: Hike the bell back between your legs and snap your hips.
Pull it high and close to your body.
Punch your hand through the handle as it passes your head.
Lock out overhead, then guide it back down.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat (Kettlebell)
exercises.summary: A wide squat with the bell hanging between your legs.
steps: Hold the bell with both hands between your legs.
Stand with feet wide and toes turned well out.
Breathe in and squat straight down.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Swing
exercises.summary: A hip snap, not a squat or a front raise. The arms just hang on.
steps: Stand with the bell a foot in front of you, feet shoulder-width.
Hinge and hike it back between your legs.
Snap your hips forward hard so the bell floats to chest height.
Let it swing back between your legs and repeat.

exercises.name: Thruster (Kettlebell)
exercises.summary: A front squat straight into a press, with no pause between.
steps: Hold the bell in the rack position against your forearm.
Breathe in and squat until your thighs reach parallel.
Drive up and let the momentum carry the bell overhead.
Lower it to the rack and repeat.

exercises.name: Kettlebell Turkish Get Up
exercises.summary: Lying to standing with the bell overhead. Learn it with no weight.
steps: Lie on your back and press the bell up with one straight arm.
Roll onto your elbow, then your hand, keeping the bell up.
Bridge your hips, sweep your leg through and come to a kneel.
Stand up, then reverse every step to lie back down.

exercises.name: Kipping Pull Up
exercises.summary: A swinging pull-up for volume. Learn strict pull-ups first.
steps: Hang from the bar and swing your hips into a gentle arc.
Drive your hips forward and pull as the swing carries you up.
Get your chin over the bar, then push away.
Fall back into the swing and repeat in rhythm.

exercises.name: Knee Raise Parallel Bars
exercises.summary: A supported knee raise. Curl the hips rather than swinging the legs.
steps: Rest your forearms on the pads and grip the handles.
Let your legs hang and brace your abs.
Curl your knees up toward your chest.
Lower them slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Kneeling Push Up
exercises.summary: A push-up from the knees, for building up to the full version.
steps: Kneel and set your hands just wider than your shoulders.
Walk your knees back so hips, shoulders and knees line up.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up and breathe out, keeping your hips forward.

exercises.name: L-Sit Hold
exercises.summary: A static core hold. Push down hard through your hands.
steps: Sit with your legs straight and hands flat beside your hips.
Press down through your hands to lift your hips off the floor.
Lift your legs until they are parallel with the floor.
Hold with straight knees and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Landmine 180
exercises.summary: A standing rotation. Pivot your feet, do not twist your knees.
steps: Wedge one end of the bar into a corner and hold the other at chest height.
Stand with feet shoulder-width and arms almost straight.
Rotate the bar down to one hip, pivoting your back foot.
Sweep it across to the other hip, pivoting the other foot.

exercises.name: Landmine Row
exercises.summary: A two-hand row on a landmine, which keeps the path fixed.
steps: Wedge one end of the bar into a corner and straddle the other.
Hinge forward with a flat back and grip the loaded end.
Breathe in and row it to your stomach.
Squeeze your back, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Landmine Squat and Press
exercises.summary: A squat that finishes with a press. One smooth movement.
steps: Hold the loaded end of a landmine bar at your chest.
Breathe in and squat until your thighs reach parallel.
Drive up and press the bar away as you stand.
Bring it back to your chest and breathe in for the next rep.

exercises.name: Lateral Band Walks
exercises.summary: Side-stepping against a band. Stay low and keep tension the whole way.
steps: Put a band above your knees and stand with feet hip-width.
Sit into a quarter squat and keep your chest up.
Step sideways, keeping the band under tension.
Walk out and back without letting your feet come together.

exercises.name: Lateral Box Jump
exercises.summary: A sideways jump onto a box. Land soft and reset every rep.
steps: Stand side-on to a box with your feet hip-width.
Dip into a quarter squat and swing your arms.
Jump sideways onto the box and land softly with bent knees.
Step back down and reset before the next rep.

exercises.name: Lateral Leg Raises
exercises.summary: A side-lying hip lift. Lead with the heel, not the toe.
steps: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and straight.
Support your head on your lower arm and brace your abs.
Lift the top leg as high as you can without tipping your hips.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Lateral Lunge
exercises.summary: A sideways lunge. The trailing leg stays straight.
steps: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step wide to one side and push your hips back.
Bend the stepping knee while the other leg stays straight.
Push back to standing, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Lateral Squat
exercises.summary: A wide-stance shift from side to side. Feet stay planted.
steps: Stand with your feet much wider than your shoulders.
Shift your weight over one leg and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight and both feet flat.
Shift across to the other side without standing up.

exercises.name: Leg Raise Parallel Bars
exercises.summary: The straight-leg version. Stop where your back starts to round.
steps: Rest your forearms on the pads and grip the handles.
Let your legs hang straight and brace your abs.
Raise your straight legs to hip height or above.
Lower them slowly without swinging.

exercises.name: Low Cable Fly Crossovers
exercises.summary: A fly from low pulleys, which sweeps up and in for the upper chest.
steps: Set both pulleys low and grip a handle in each hand.
Step forward with your arms down and out, elbows soft.
Sweep your hands up and together in front of your chest.
Lower them slowly back out to your sides.

exercises.name: Lunge
exercises.summary: A split-stance squat. Drop straight down, do not lean forward.
steps: Stand tall and step one foot forward into a long stride.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Bend both knees until your back knee nears the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Lying Knee Raise
exercises.summary: A gentle hip curl for the lower abs. Keep your back flat.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands flat beside your hips.
Bend your knees to ninety degrees over your hips.
Breathe out and draw your knees toward your chest.
Lower slowly, stopping before your back arches.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Raise
exercises.summary: A straight-leg raise. Stop the moment your lower back lifts.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands flat beside your hips.
Keep your legs straight and press your lower back into the floor.
Breathe out and raise your legs until they point at the ceiling.
Lower slowly and stop before your back arches.

exercises.name: Lying Neck Curls
exercises.summary: Neck flexion. Move slowly and never force the range.
steps: Lie face up on a bench with your head just past the end.
Let your head drop back to a comfortable stretch.
Tuck your chin and curl your head up toward your chest.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Lying Neck Extension
exercises.summary: Neck extension. Slow and short-range, never a fast snap.
steps: Lie face down on a bench with your head just past the end.
Let your head drop forward to a comfortable stretch.
Lift your head back until you are looking forward.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Machine)
exercises.summary: A seated back extension with the range set by the machine.
steps: Adjust the seat and set the pad against your upper back.
Cross your arms and brace your abs.
Push back until your torso is upright or slightly past it.
Return slowly under control.

exercises.name: Belt Squat (Machine)
exercises.summary: A squat loaded at the hips, so nothing sits on your spine.
steps: Fasten the belt and clip it to the machine's lever.
Stand on the platform, feet shoulder-width, toes turned slightly out.
Hold the handles, brace your abs, and unrack the weight.
Breathe in and squat until your thighs are parallel.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided curl, which stops the elbows drifting.
steps: Set the weight and adjust the seat so your arms rest flat.
Sit down and take a handle in each hand.
Breathe in and curl one arm until your hand passes your elbow.
Breathe out, lower slowly, then curl the other arm.

exercises.name: Calf Extension (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided calf raise. Pause at both ends of the range.
steps: Set the weight and place the balls of your feet on the platform.
Let your heels drop until you feel a stretch.
Press through your toes to rise as high as you can.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Calf Press (Machine)
exercises.summary: Calf raises on the leg press platform. Full range, no bouncing.
steps: Sit in the leg press with the balls of your feet on the platform edge.
Straighten your legs and release the safeties.
Let your heels drop for a stretch, then press through your toes.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided fly. Set the seat so your arms open at chest height.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles sit level with your chest.
Sit back and grip the handles with soft elbows.
Squeeze your chest to bring the handles together.
Open your arms slowly until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided chest press. Set the seat so the handles meet your chest.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles line up with your lower chest.
Sit back with your shoulder blades against the pad.
Breathe in, then press the handles forward until your arms straighten.
Let them come back slowly and breathe out.

exercises.name: Crunch (Machine)
exercises.summary: A loaded crunch. The machine fixes the range so you cannot cheat.
steps: Adjust the seat and grip the handles over your shoulders.
Sit with your back against the pad.
Crunch your ribs toward your hips against the weight.
Return slowly under control.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Machine)
exercises.summary: A machine press angled downward for the lower chest.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at lower-chest height.
Sit back and grip the handles.
Press them forward and down until your arms straighten.
Let them come back slowly under control.

exercises.name: Glute Kickback (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided glute kickback. Stop when your back wants to arch.
steps: Set the machine and place one foot on the pad.
Hold the supports and brace your abs.
Push the pad back until your thigh lines up with your torso.
Return slowly, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Hack Squat (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided squat with your back supported. Very quad-dominant.
steps: Set your shoulders under the pads and feet shoulder-width.
Release the safeties and brace your abs.
Breathe in and lower until your thighs reach parallel.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Hip Abduction (Machine)
exercises.summary: Pushing the knees apart against the pads. Keep your back on the seat.
steps: Sit with the pads against the outside of your knees.
Sit tall with your back against the seat.
Push your knees apart as far as they will go.
Return slowly under control.

exercises.name: Hip Adduction (Machine)
exercises.summary: Squeezing the knees together. Control the opening, do not let it snap.
steps: Sit with the pads against the inside of your knees.
Sit tall with your back against the seat.
Squeeze your knees together as far as they will go.
Let them open slowly under control.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided thrust, which loads the glutes without setting up a bar.
steps: Sit in the machine and set the pad across your hips.
Plant your feet flat and brace your abs.
Drive through your heels to extend your hips.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.summary: A machine press angled upward for the upper chest.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at upper-chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades against the pad.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms straighten.
Let them come back slowly under control.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Chest Press (Machine)
exercises.summary: A plate-loaded press where each arm moves independently.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at chest height.
Sit back with your shoulder blades against the pad.
Press both handles forward until your arms straighten.
Let them come back slowly under control.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral High Row (Machine)
exercises.summary: A high row that pulls down and back, which biases the lats.
steps: Sit with your chest on the pad and grip the high handles.
Let your arms straighten up and forward.
Pull the handles down and back toward your ribs.
Squeeze, then let them out slowly.

exercises.name: Iso-Lateral Row (Machine)
exercises.summary: A plate-loaded row where each arm works on its own.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles sit at chest height.
Sit with your chest against the pad and grip both handles.
Pull them back until your elbows pass your torso.
Squeeze, then let them out slowly.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown (Machine)
exercises.summary: A pulldown on a fixed machine, which keeps the path honest.
steps: Set the weight and adjust the thigh pads to hold you down.
Grip the handles and let your arms straighten.
Pull the handles to your upper chest.
Squeeze, then let them rise slowly.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided side raise. The pads mean you cannot swing.
steps: Adjust the seat so the pads sit against your upper arms.
Sit tall and grip the handles.
Push the pads out and up to shoulder height.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Leg Extension (Machine)
exercises.summary: Direct quad work. Pause at the top rather than swinging up.
steps: Adjust the seat so your knees line up with the pivot.
Hook your shins behind the pad and grip the handles.
Straighten your legs and squeeze your quads at the top.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Leg Press (Machine)
exercises.summary: A heavy quad press. Never let your lower back lift off the pad.
steps: Sit in the machine with your feet shoulder-width on the platform.
Release the safeties and straighten your legs without locking out.
Breathe in and lower until your knees reach about ninety degrees.
Press back up through your heels and breathe out.

exercises.name: Leg Press Horizontal (Machine)
exercises.summary: A seated horizontal press, which is kinder to the lower back.
steps: Sit with your back against the pad and feet on the platform.
Release the safeties and straighten your legs.
Lower until your knees reach about ninety degrees.
Press back out through your heels.

exercises.name: Lying Leg Curl (Machine)
exercises.summary: Hamstring curls face down. Keep your hips pressed into the pad.
steps: Lie face down with the pad just above your heels.
Grip the handles and press your hips into the bench.
Curl your heels toward your buttocks.
Lower slowly under control.

exercises.name: Pendulum Squat (Machine)
exercises.summary: A squat on an arced path, which stays smooth on the knees.
steps: Set your shoulders under the pads and feet on the platform.
Release the safeties and brace your abs.
Lower until your thighs reach parallel.
Push through your whole foot to stand.

exercises.name: Shoulder Press (Machine Plates)
exercises.summary: A plate-loaded overhead press with a fixed, safe path.
steps: Load the plates and adjust the seat to shoulder height.
Sit back and grip the handles.
Press them overhead until your arms straighten.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Preacher Curl (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided preacher curl. The pad stops the elbows drifting.
steps: Adjust the seat so your armpits rest over the top of the pad.
Grip the handles with your palms up and arms nearly straight.
Curl the handles toward your chin.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

exercises.name: Pullover (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided lat pullover. The elbows stay fixed on the pads.
steps: Adjust the seat and rest your elbows on the pads.
Grip the bar and let your arms travel back overhead.
Pull the bar down and forward using your lats.
Let it rise slowly back overhead.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Reverse Fly (Machine)
exercises.summary: A pec deck run backwards for the rear delts.
steps: Set the handles forward and sit facing the pad.
Grip the handles with your arms out in front.
Sweep your arms back and out to your sides.
Squeeze, then return slowly under control.

exercises.name: Rear Kick (Machine)
exercises.summary: A machine kickback that isolates one glute at a time.
steps: Set the machine and place one foot against the pad.
Hold the handles with your torso supported.
Push the pad back until your hip is fully extended.
Return slowly, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl (Machine)
exercises.summary: Hamstring curls seated, which loads them at a longer length.
steps: Adjust the seat and set the pad just above your heels.
Lower the thigh pad and grip the handles.
Curl your heels down and back underneath you.
Let them return slowly under control.

exercises.name: Seated Row (Machine)
exercises.summary: A chest-supported row. Pull to the ribs and hold for a beat.
steps: Set the weight and adjust the chest pad to your height.
Sit with your chest against the pad and grip the handles.
Pull the handles to your ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then let them out slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Shoulder Press (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided overhead press. Set the seat so the handles reach your shoulders.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles sit level with your shoulders.
Sit back with your abs braced.
Press the handles overhead until your arms straighten.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Shrug (Machine)
exercises.summary: A trap shrug on a fixed machine. Straight up, no rolling.
steps: Set the weight and grip the handles at your sides.
Stand tall with your arms straight.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears.
Hold for a second, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Single Leg Press (Machine)
exercises.summary: A one-legged press, which evens out a side-to-side difference.
steps: Sit in the machine and place one foot in the middle of the platform.
Release the safeties and straighten that leg.
Lower until your knee reaches about ninety degrees.
Press back up, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Single Leg Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
exercises.summary: One calf at a time on the machine, which doubles the load.
steps: Set the pads and stand on one foot on the step.
Let that heel drop until you feel a stretch.
Press through your toes to rise as high as you can.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Squat (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided squat, which lets you go heavy without balancing.
steps: Set the shoulder pads and stand with your feet shoulder-width.
Release the safeties and brace your abs.
Lower until your thighs reach parallel.
Push through your heels to stand.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Machine)
exercises.summary: The standard loaded calf raise. Straight legs, full stretch.
steps: Set the shoulder pads and stand with the balls of your feet on the step.
Straighten your legs and let your heels drop.
Press through your toes to rise as high as you can.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided extension. The seat and pads do the stabilising for you.
steps: Adjust the seat so your elbows line up with the pivot.
Sit with your upper arms on the pad and grip the handles.
Extend your elbows until your arms are straight.
Bend them slowly back under control.

exercises.name: Vertical Traction (Machine)
exercises.summary: A guided pulldown with chest support, common in gym circuits.
steps: Adjust the seat so the handles sit above your shoulders.
Sit with your chest against the pad and grip the handles.
Pull them down until your elbows pass your ribs.
Let them rise slowly under control.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.summary: A plank with fast knee drives. Keep the hips low.
steps: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then swap quickly.
Keep alternating at a steady pace without lifting your hips.

exercises.name: Muscle Up
exercises.summary: A pull-up into a dip. Very advanced, and a coach helps.
steps: Hang from the bar or rings with a firm grip.
Pull explosively so your chest clears the bar.
Roll your wrists over the top and press to straight arms.
Lower back through the same path under control.

exercises.name: Negative Pull Up
exercises.summary: Lowering from the top, for building up to a full pull-up.
steps: Step or jump so your chin starts above the bar.
Set your shoulders down and brace your abs.
Lower yourself as slowly as you can, aiming for three to five seconds.
Step back up to the top rather than pulling.

exercises.name: Nordic Hamstrings Curls
exercises.summary: The hardest hamstring movement. Lower slowly and catch yourself.
steps: Kneel with your ankles anchored under something solid.
Squeeze your glutes so hips, knees and shoulders stay in line.
Lower your torso forward as slowly as you can control.
Catch yourself with your hands and push back to the start.

exercises.name: Oblique Crunch
exercises.summary: A crunch angled onto one side. Work one side fully, then swap.
steps: Lie on your side with knees bent and stacked.
Rest your top hand behind your head.
Breathe out and curl your top shoulder toward your hip.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then swap sides.

exercises.name: One Arm Push Up
exercises.summary: A one-arm press. Widen your feet to stop your hips twisting.
steps: Set your feet wide and place one hand under your chest.
Tuck the other arm behind your back.
Breathe in and lower your chest under control.
Press back up without letting your hips rotate, and breathe out.

exercises.name: Overhead Dumbbell Lunge
exercises.summary: A lunge holding weight overhead. Brace hard so you do not arch.
steps: Press a dumbbell overhead with a locked elbow.
Brace your abs and step forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nears the floor.
Push through your front heel to stand, keeping the weight overhead.

exercises.name: Overhead Plate Raise
exercises.summary: A front raise taken all the way overhead.
steps: Hold a plate at the sides with both hands in front of your thighs.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Raise the plate in an arc until it is straight overhead.
Lower it slowly along the same path.

exercises.name: Overhead Squat
exercises.summary: A squat holding the bar overhead. Start with an empty bar.
steps: Take a wide grip and press the bar overhead with locked elbows.
Set your feet shoulder-width and brace your abs.
Breathe in and squat while keeping the bar above your mid-foot.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Butterfly (Pec Deck)
exercises.summary: A guided chest fly. Set the seat so the pads meet at chest height.
steps: Set the weight and the seat so the pads sit at chest height.
Sit down, grip the handles, and set your shoulders back.
Breathe in, then squeeze your chest to bring the handles together.
Breathe out at the front, then open your arms slowly.

exercises.name: Pike Pushup
exercises.summary: A vertical press for the shoulders. Aim the crown of your head down.
steps: Start in a push-up position and walk your feet in to pike your hips.
Set your hands shoulder-width with your head between your arms.
Breathe in and lower the crown of your head toward the floor.
Press back up and breathe out.

exercises.name: Pilates
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Pistol Squat
exercises.summary: A full one-legged squat. Hold a rack if your balance is not there yet.
steps: Stand on one leg and reach the other leg forward.
Hold your arms out in front for balance.
Breathe in and squat as low as you can control.
Push through your heel to stand, then swap legs.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.summary: A whole-body brace. Squeeze your glutes to stop your hips sagging.
steps: Rest on your forearms with your elbows under your shoulders.
Straighten your body from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes and pull your belly button in.
Hold and breathe steadily without letting your hips drop.

exercises.name: Plank Pushup
exercises.summary: Moving between forearm and hand plank. Keep the hips still.
steps: Start in a forearm plank with your body straight.
Press one hand into the floor, then the other, to reach a high plank.
Lower back to one forearm, then the other.
Keep your hips level throughout and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Plate Curl
exercises.summary: A curl gripping the plate itself, which taxes the hands.
steps: Hold a plate at the sides with both hands, arms straight.
Keep your elbows at your sides and stand tall.
Curl the plate up to chest height.
Lower it slowly under control.

exercises.name: Plate Front Raise
exercises.summary: A front raise holding a plate like a steering wheel.
steps: Hold a plate at the sides with both hands in front of your thighs.
Brace your abs and keep your arms almost straight.
Raise the plate to shoulder height.
Lower it slowly under control.

exercises.name: Plate Press
exercises.summary: A press holding the plate flat, squeezing it the whole time.
steps: Hold a plate flat between your palms at your chest.
Squeeze it hard and keep squeezing throughout.
Press it straight out until your arms are locked.
Bring it back to your chest under control.

exercises.name: Power Clean
exercises.summary: A clean caught above parallel, so there is no deep squat.
steps: Set up over the bar as for a deadlift.
Pull the bar past your knees, keeping it close.
Extend your hips and shrug hard.
Drop under and catch the bar on your shoulders in a quarter squat.

exercises.name: Power Snatch
exercises.summary: A snatch caught above parallel, so there is no deep catch.
steps: Set up over the bar with a wide grip.
Pull the bar past your knees and extend your hips explosively.
Shrug and pull yourself under the bar.
Catch it overhead in a quarter squat and stand tall.

exercises.name: Press Under
exercises.summary: A drill for getting under the bar fast. Light loads only.
steps: Hold the bar at your shoulders with a snatch-width grip.
Press up against the bar and pull your body down beneath it.
Finish in a squat with the bar locked out overhead.
Stand up, then reset for the next rep.

exercises.name: Pull Up
exercises.summary: The main vertical pull. Lead with the elbows, not the chin.
steps: Grip the bar just wider than your shoulders, palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and pull your shoulders down.
Breathe in and pull your chest toward the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight, and breathe out.

exercises.name: Push Press
exercises.summary: An overhead press using a leg dip to start the bar moving.
steps: Hold the bar on your front shoulders with feet hip-width.
Breathe in and dip a few inches by bending your knees.
Drive up hard with your legs and press the bar overhead.
Lock out, then lower to your shoulders and breathe out.

exercises.name: Push Up
exercises.summary: The base pressing pattern. Move as one plank, hips included.
steps: Set your hands just wider than your shoulders, body straight.
Squeeze your glutes so your hips do not sag.
Breathe in and lower until your chest is a fist off the floor.
Press back up until your elbows lock and breathe out.

exercises.name: Push Up - Close Grip
exercises.summary: A push-up shifted onto the triceps by narrowing the hands.
steps: Set your hands directly under your shoulders, body straight.
Keep your elbows brushing your ribs, not flared out.
Breathe in and lower your chest toward your thumbs.
Press back up and breathe out.

exercises.name: Rack Pull
exercises.summary: A partial deadlift from pins, so you can handle a heavier top half.
steps: Set the safety pins at knee height and load the bar.
Grip the bar just outside your knees and brace hard.
Lift your chest and pull the bar up your thighs to lockout.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower to the pins.

exercises.name: Recumbent Bike
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Reverse Crunch
exercises.summary: The abs curl the hips off the floor rather than lifting the shoulders.
steps: Lie on your back with your hands flat beside your hips.
Bend your knees and bring them over your hips.
Breathe out and curl your hips off the floor toward your ribs.
Lower slowly without letting your feet touch down.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Concentration Curl
exercises.summary: A concentration curl with the palm down, which shifts work to the forearm.
steps: Sit with your legs apart and a dumbbell in one hand, palm down.
Brace that elbow against the inside of your thigh.
Curl the weight up with your palm facing away.
Lower it slowly, finish your reps and swap arms.

exercises.name: Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown
exercises.summary: An underhand pushdown, which favours the inner head of the triceps.
steps: Grip a straight bar on a high pulley with your palms up.
Pin your elbows to your sides and stand tall.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let it rise slowly under control.

exercises.name: Reverse Hyperextension
exercises.summary: The legs swing rather than the torso, which spares the spine.
steps: Lie face down on the machine with your hips at the edge.
Grip the handles and let your legs hang down.
Squeeze your glutes to raise your legs to hip height.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Reverse Lunge
exercises.summary: A lunge stepping backwards, which is kinder to the knees.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width.
Breathe in and step one foot back into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nears the floor.
Push through your front heel to return and breathe out.

exercises.name: Reverse Plank
exercises.summary: A face-up brace. Drive the hips up and open the chest.
steps: Sit with your legs straight and hands flat behind your hips.
Press into your hands and lift your hips until your body is straight.
Squeeze your glutes and look up.
Hold and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Ring Dips
exercises.summary: A dip on rings. The wobble is the point, so start shallow.
steps: Grip the rings and press up to straight arms, rings turned out.
Lean your torso slightly forward and brace your abs.
Breathe in and lower until your shoulders sit below your elbows.
Press back up to straight arms and breathe out.

exercises.name: Ring Pull Up
exercises.summary: A pull-up on rings, which lets your wrists rotate naturally.
steps: Hang from the rings with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down and brace your abs.
Pull your chest to the rings, turning your palms in as you rise.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Ring Push Up
exercises.summary: A push-up on rings. The instability makes light work feel heavy.
steps: Set the rings just off the floor and grip one in each hand.
Get into a push-up position with your body straight.
Lower your chest between the rings under control.
Press back up and turn the rings out at the top.

exercises.name: Rope Cable Curl
exercises.summary: A curl on a rope, which lets you turn your wrists out at the top.
steps: Attach a rope to a low pulley and grip both ends.
Stand tall with your elbows at your sides.
Curl the rope up, turning your palms out at the top.
Lower it slowly under control.

exercises.name: Rope Straight Arm Pulldown
exercises.summary: The rope version, which lets your hands split apart at the bottom.
steps: Grip a rope on a high pulley with straight arms.
Hinge slightly forward and brace your abs.
Pull the rope down in an arc, spreading your hands at the bottom.
Let it rise slowly with your elbows straight.

exercises.name: Rowing Machine
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Running
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (Sandbag)
exercises.summary: Walking lunges under a sandbag. The shifting load taxes the core.
steps: Rest the sandbag across your shoulders and grip it.
Step one foot forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nears the floor.
Drive through the front heel and step the back foot through.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull Ups
exercises.summary: The first inch of a pull-up. Arms stay straight throughout.
steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms and shoulders relaxed up.
Without bending your elbows, pull your shoulders down and back.
Hold for a second at the top.
Let your shoulders rise again under control.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row - Bar Grip
exercises.summary: A cable row with a straight bar. Sit tall and stop the swing.
steps: Sit with your feet on the plate and knees slightly bent.
Grip the bar overhand and sit tall with a flat back.
Pull the bar to your stomach, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze, then let your arms straighten slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row - Bar Wide Grip
exercises.summary: A wide-grip cable row, which favours the upper back.
steps: Sit with your feet on the plate and grip a wide bar overhand.
Sit tall with a flat back and brace your abs.
Pull the bar to your upper stomach, elbows flaring out.
Squeeze your shoulder blades, then let it out slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raise
exercises.summary: A bent-knee calf raise, which targets the soleus underneath.
steps: Sit and set the pad across your thighs, feet on the platform.
Release the safety and let your heels drop.
Press through your toes to lift the pad as high as it goes.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Dip Machine
exercises.summary: A guided dip from a seat, which is far easier to load lightly.
steps: Adjust the seat and grip the handles at your sides.
Sit tall with your back against the pad.
Press the handles down until your arms straighten.
Let them rise slowly under control.

exercises.name: Seated Palms Up Wrist Curl
exercises.summary: Forearm flexion. Let the weight roll to your fingers for full range.
steps: Sit and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms up.
Let your wrists hang past your knees holding the dumbbells.
Let the weight roll toward your fingers, then curl it back.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Seated Triceps Press
exercises.summary: A seated overhead press for the triceps on a machine.
steps: Adjust the seat and grip the handles behind your head.
Sit tall with your back against the pad.
Press the handles up until your arms straighten.
Lower them slowly under control.

exercises.name: Shoulder Taps
exercises.summary: A plank that fights rotation. Wider feet make it easier.
steps: Start in a high plank with your feet a little wider than usual.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Return it and tap with the other, keeping your hips level.

exercises.name: Side Bend
exercises.summary: A side flexion for the obliques. Bend sideways only, no twisting.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width and one hand behind your head.
Brace your abs and keep your hips square.
Bend sideways toward your free hand and breathe out.
Return to upright, finish your reps, then swap sides.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.summary: A side brace for the obliques. Stack the hips, do not let them roll.
steps: Lie on your side with your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your feet and lift your hips off the floor.
Make one straight line from head to heels.
Hold and breathe steadily, then swap sides.

exercises.name: Single Arm Cable Crossover
exercises.summary: A one-arm crossover, which lets you squeeze right across the midline.
steps: Set one pulley at shoulder height and grip the handle.
Step forward with your arm out to the side, elbow soft.
Sweep your hand across your body past the midline.
Return slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Single Arm Cable Row
exercises.summary: A one-arm cable row, which lets the shoulder blade travel further.
steps: Sit or stand facing a low pulley with a single handle.
Let your arm straighten and your shoulder reach forward.
Pull your elbow back past your ribs.
Let it out slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Single Arm Lat Pulldown
exercises.summary: A one-arm pulldown, which lets each side work its own range.
steps: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and kneel or sit.
Let your arm straighten fully overhead.
Pull your elbow down toward your ribs.
Let it rise slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: Single Leg Extensions
exercises.summary: One quad at a time, which evens out a side-to-side difference.
steps: Adjust the seat and hook one shin behind the pad.
Grip the handles and sit tall.
Straighten that leg and squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Single Leg Glute Bridge
exercises.summary: A one-legged bridge. Keep both hips level as you lift.
steps: Lie on your back with one knee bent and that foot flat.
Lift the other leg straight or hold that knee to your chest.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Squeeze at the top, lower slowly, then swap legs.

exercises.name: Single Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.summary: A one-legged thrust. Keep the hips square, not tilted.
steps: Rest your upper back on a bench and plant one foot flat.
Lift the other leg and hold it clear of the floor.
Drive through the planted heel to lift your hips.
Squeeze at the top, lower slowly, then swap legs.

exercises.name: Single Leg Standing Calf Raise
exercises.summary: One calf at a time, which doubles the load without any weight.
steps: Stand on one foot with the other hooked behind your ankle.
Hold a wall or rail for balance.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of your foot.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Sit Up
exercises.summary: A full-range ab curl. Roll up one vertebra at a time.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet anchored or flat.
Cross your arms on your chest.
Breathe out and curl all the way up until your chest meets your thighs.
Lower slowly and breathe in.

exercises.name: Skating
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Ski Erg
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Skiing
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Sled Pull
exercises.summary: Dragging a loaded sled backwards or by a strap.
steps: Hold the straps or harness and lean away from the sled.
Keep your arms firm and your back flat.
Walk backwards or forwards with short, driving steps.
Keep the strap tight for the whole distance.

exercises.name: Sled Push
exercises.summary: Driving a loaded sled. Low body angle, short choppy steps.
steps: Grip the sled's uprights and lean your body forward.
Keep your arms firm and your back flat.
Drive through the balls of your feet with short steps.
Keep pushing for the set distance without standing up.

exercises.name: Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.summary: A bench press on rails. No balancing, so you can push closer to failure.
steps: Set a bench so the bar sits over your lower chest.
Lie back and grip the bar just wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulder blades together and unrack the bar.
Breathe in and lower it to touch your chest.
Press up until your elbows lock and breathe out.

exercises.name: Bent Over Row (Smith Machine)
exercises.summary: A row on a fixed bar path, which lets you focus on the pull.
steps: Set the bar at mid-thigh and stand close, feet hip-width.
Grip the bar overhand at shoulder width and unrack it.
Hinge forward with a flat back until the bar reaches mid-shin.
Breathe in and pull the bar to your stomach.
Squeeze your back, breathe out, and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Smith Machine)
exercises.summary: A deadlift on rails. The bar path is fixed, so set your feet carefully.
steps: Set the bar at shin height and stand with it over your mid-foot.
Hinge down and grip it just outside your knees.
Lift your chest, brace hard and stand up.
Lower the bar along the same path under control.

exercises.name: Decline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.summary: A Smith press on a decline, aimed at the lower chest.
steps: Set a decline bench so the bar sits over your lower chest.
Hook your legs in and grip the bar just wider than your shoulders.
Unrack it, breathe in and lower it to your chest.
Press up until your elbows lock and breathe out.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust (Smith Machine)
exercises.summary: A thrust with the bar on rails, so it cannot roll off.
steps: Sit with your upper back on a bench under the bar.
Unrack it across your hips with a pad in place.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips level with your knees.
Squeeze at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Incline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.summary: A Smith press on an incline, aimed at the upper chest.
steps: Set an incline bench so the bar sits over your upper chest.
Lie back and grip the bar just wider than your shoulders.
Unrack it, breathe in and lower it to your upper chest.
Press up until your elbows lock and breathe out.

exercises.name: Overhead Press (Smith Machine)
exercises.summary: A Smith overhead press. The fixed path means no balancing.
steps: Set a bench under the bar so it sits at chin height.
Sit with your back supported and grip just outside your shoulders.
Unrack the bar, breathe in and press it overhead.
Lower it to chin height and breathe out.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift (Smith Machine)
exercises.summary: A hinge on a fixed bar path, useful for learning the pattern.
steps: Set the bar at thigh height and unrack it with an overhand grip.
Soften your knees and brace your abs.
Push your hips back and lower the bar down your legs.
Stop at a hamstring stretch, then drive your hips forward.

exercises.name: Shrug (Smith Machine)
exercises.summary: A trap shrug on the Smith, which fixes the bar path.
steps: Set the bar at thigh height and grip it overhand.
Unrack it and stand tall with straight arms.
Shrug your shoulders straight up toward your ears.
Hold for a second, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Squat (Smith Machine)
exercises.summary: A squat on a fixed bar path, with your feet slightly forward.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and step your feet slightly forward.
Unrack it by turning your wrists and brace your abs.
Lower until your thighs reach parallel.
Push through your heels to stand.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise (Smith)
exercises.summary: A calf raise under the Smith bar, with a step for range.
steps: Set the bar on your upper back and stand on a step.
Unrack it and let your heels drop for a stretch.
Press through your toes to rise as high as you can.
Squeeze at the top and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Snatch
exercises.summary: Floor to overhead in one pull. Coaching before load, always.
steps: Set up over the bar with a wide grip.
Pull the bar past your knees, keeping it close to your body.
Extend your hips explosively and shrug.
Drop under and catch the bar overhead with locked arms, then stand.

exercises.name: Snowboarding
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Spiderman
exercises.summary: A plank with a knee drive. Keep your hips low as the knee comes up.
steps: Start in a high plank with your body straight.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Drive your right knee toward your right elbow.
Return it and repeat on the left, keeping your hips level.

exercises.name: Spinning
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Split Jerk
exercises.summary: An overhead lift caught in a split stance. Feet land at the same time.
steps: Hold the bar on your front shoulders with feet hip-width.
Dip a few inches by bending your knees.
Drive up hard and punch the bar overhead.
Split your feet front and back as you catch, then recover them.

exercises.name: Sprints
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Squat Row
exercises.summary: A squat and a row in one, using a cable to counterbalance you.
steps: Grip a low-pulley handle and sit back into a squat.
Let the cable pull your arms straight at the bottom.
Stand up and row the handle to your stomach at the same time.
Lower back into the next squat as your arms straighten.

exercises.name: Standing Cable Glute Kickbacks
exercises.summary: A cable kickback with an ankle strap. Small range, big squeeze.
steps: Strap a low pulley to one ankle and face the machine.
Hold the frame and brace your abs.
Drive that leg back and up, squeezing your glute.
Return slowly, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raise
exercises.summary: A calf raise from the floor. Pause at the top, do not bounce.
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width, holding a wall for balance.
Press through the balls of your feet to rise as high as you can.
Pause and squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly until your heels touch down.

exercises.name: Standing Leg Curls
exercises.summary: One hamstring at a time, standing. Keep your hips still.
steps: Stand in the machine with the pad behind one ankle.
Hold the support and brace your abs.
Curl that heel toward your buttocks.
Lower slowly, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Step Up
exercises.summary: Stepping onto a box. Drive from the top leg, do not push off below.
steps: Stand facing a box and place one whole foot on top.
Keep your chest up and brace your abs.
Drive through that heel to stand up on the box.
Step down under control, finish your reps and swap legs.

exercises.name: Stair Machine (Steps)
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Straight Leg Deadlift
exercises.summary: A hinge with near-locked knees. Range is smaller than it looks.
steps: Stand holding the bar at your thighs with your knees almost straight.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Push your hips back and lower the bar down your legs.
Stop when your back would round, then drive your hips forward.

exercises.name: Stretching
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Sumo Deadlift
exercises.summary: A wide-stance deadlift. It shortens the pull and spares the back.
steps: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out, shins near the bar.
Grip the bar inside your knees with straight arms.
Drop your hips, lift your chest and brace hard.
Push your knees out and drive the floor away to stand.
Lock out your hips, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Sumo Squat
exercises.summary: A wide squat that pulls in the inner thigh. Turn your toes out.
steps: Stand with your feet wide and toes turned out to about forty-five degrees.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Sit straight down, keeping your knees tracking over your toes.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.

exercises.name: Superman
exercises.summary: A back extension from the floor. Lift low, do not crank your neck.
steps: Lie face down with your arms reaching forward.
Squeeze your glutes and breathe in.
Lift your arms, chest and legs a few inches off the floor.
Hold for a moment, lower slowly and breathe out.

exercises.name: Bicep Curl (Suspension)
exercises.summary: A body-weight curl. Walk your feet in to make it easier.
steps: Hold a handle in each hand and walk your feet forward.
Lean back with your body straight and glutes squeezed.
Breathe in and bend your elbows to pull yourself up.
Breathe out at the top, then lower slowly.

exercises.name: Chest Fly (Suspension)
exercises.summary: A body-weight fly. The further forward you lean, the harder it gets.
steps: Face away from the anchor with a handle in each hand.
Lean forward with your arms out and elbows soft.
Open your arms wide until your chest stretches.
Squeeze your chest to bring your hands back together.

exercises.name: Front Raise (Suspension)
exercises.summary: A body-weight front raise. Keep your body in one straight line.
steps: Face the anchor and hold a handle in each hand.
Lean back with straight arms and a braced body.
Raise your arms overhead to pull yourself upright.
Lower back slowly under control.

exercises.name: Jack Knife (Suspension)
exercises.summary: A plank with your feet in the straps, drawing the knees in.
steps: Put both feet in the straps and get into a high plank.
Brace your abs so your hips do not sag.
Draw your knees toward your chest.
Extend them back out slowly under control.

exercises.name: Low Row (Suspension)
exercises.summary: A body-weight row. Walk your feet forward to make it harder.
steps: Hold a handle in each hand and lean back with straight arms.
Keep your body in one line from head to heels.
Pull your chest toward your hands, leading with your elbows.
Lower yourself slowly under control.

exercises.name: Squat (Suspension)
exercises.summary: A squat holding the straps, which helps you reach full depth.
steps: Hold a handle in each hand and stand facing the anchor.
Set your feet shoulder-width and take up the slack.
Squat down as deep as you can, using the straps for balance.
Push through your heels to stand.

exercises.name: Triceps Extension (Suspension)
exercises.summary: A body-weight extension. Only the elbows move.
steps: Face away from the anchor with a handle in each hand.
Lean forward with your arms straight ahead.
Bend your elbows to lower your head between your hands.
Extend your elbows to press back to the start.

exercises.name: Plate Squeeze (Svend Press)
exercises.summary: A chest squeeze with no lowering phase. Tension is the whole point.
steps: Press two plates flat together at chest height.
Squeeze them into each other as hard as you can.
Press them straight out in front of your chest.
Pull them back in without stopping the squeeze.

exercises.name: Swimming
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: T Bar Row
exercises.summary: A heavy hinged row. Keep your back flat, not rounded.
steps: Straddle the bar and grip the handles with a flat back.
Hinge until your torso is around forty-five degrees.
Pull the handles to your stomach, driving your elbows back.
Lower under control without letting your back round.

exercises.name: Toe Touch
exercises.summary: A short upward reach. The shoulder blades must leave the floor.
steps: Lie on your back and point both legs at the ceiling.
Reach your arms up toward your toes.
Breathe out and curl your shoulder blades off the floor.
Lower slowly and breathe in.

exercises.name: Toes to Bar
exercises.summary: A hanging core movement. Swing comes from the shoulders, not the legs.
steps: Hang from the bar with straight arms and squeeze your shoulders down.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Curl your hips up and bring your toes to touch the bar.
Lower under control and breathe out.

exercises.name: Torso Rotation
exercises.summary: A loaded twist. Light weight and slow, the spine does not like speed.
steps: Sit in the machine with your legs locked and chest against the pad.
Grip the handles and brace your abs.
Rotate your torso to one side as far as it comfortably goes.
Return slowly, then work the other side.

exercises.name: Deadlift (Trap bar)
exercises.summary: A deadlift with the load beside you, which is easier on the back.
steps: Step into the middle of the trap bar with feet hip-width.
Hinge down and grip both handles.
Drop your hips, lift your chest and brace hard.
Push the floor away and stand tall.
Lower under control, keeping your back flat.

exercises.name: Treadmill
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip
exercises.summary: A dip held upright, which keeps the load on the triceps.
steps: Grip the parallel bars and press up to straight arms.
Keep your torso upright and your elbows tucked in.
Breathe in and lower until your elbows reach ninety degrees.
Press back up to straight arms and breathe out.

exercises.name: Triceps Pressdown
exercises.summary: A pushdown by another name. Keep your upper arms still.
steps: Grip a bar on a high pulley with your elbows at your sides.
Stand tall and brace your abs.
Press the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let it rise slowly under control.

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown
exercises.summary: The standard cable pushdown. Only the elbows move.
steps: Attach a straight bar to a high pulley and grip it overhand.
Stand tall with your elbows pinned to your sides.
Push the bar down until your arms are straight.
Let it rise slowly without letting your elbows drift.

exercises.name: Triceps Rope Pushdown
exercises.summary: A pushdown on a rope, which lets you split your hands at the bottom.
steps: Grip a rope on a high pulley with your elbows at your sides.
Push down and spread your hands apart at the bottom.
Squeeze your triceps with your arms straight.
Let the rope rise slowly under control.

exercises.name: Cable Twist (Up to down)
exercises.summary: A diagonal chop downward. Same pivot, opposite direction.
steps: Set a high pulley and grip the handle with both hands.
Stand side-on with the handle above your outside shoulder.
Sweep it diagonally down and across to your far hip.
Return slowly, finish your reps and swap sides.

exercises.name: V Up
exercises.summary: A sharper jackknife. Keep your legs straight and your back long.
steps: Lie flat with your arms overhead and legs straight.
Breathe out and fold at the hips, reaching hands toward toes.
Balance on your hips for a moment at the top.
Lower both halves slowly and breathe in.

exercises.name: Walking
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge
exercises.summary: Lunges travelling forward. Keep your torso upright throughout.
steps: Stand tall and step one foot forward into a long stride.
Bend both knees until your back knee nears the floor.
Drive through the front heel and step the back foot through.
Keep alternating and travelling forward.

exercises.name: Wall Ball
exercises.summary: A squat into a throw. Catch it and go straight into the next rep.
steps: Hold a medicine ball at your chest, facing a wall.
Squat until your thighs reach parallel.
Drive up and throw the ball at a high target on the wall.
Catch it on the way down and sink into the next squat.

exercises.name: Wall Sit
exercises.summary: An isometric squat hold. Thighs parallel, back flat to the wall.
steps: Stand with your back against a wall and walk your feet out.
Slide down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
Keep your knees over your ankles and your back flat.
Hold and breathe steadily.

exercises.name: Warm Up
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Chest Dip (Weighted)
exercises.summary: A chest dip with a plate on a belt.
steps: Hang a plate from a dip belt and grip the bars.
Press up to straight arms and lean your torso forward.
Lower until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Press back up under control.

exercises.name: Chin Up (Weighted)
exercises.summary: An underhand pull-up with added weight on a belt.
steps: Hang a plate from a dip belt around your waist.
Grip the bar shoulder-width with palms facing you.
Pull your chest toward the bar without swinging.
Lower yourself slowly under control.

exercises.name: Crunch (Weighted)
exercises.summary: A crunch holding a plate on your chest once reps get easy.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and a plate on your chest.
Hold the plate with both hands and brace your abs.
Breathe out and curl your shoulder blades off the floor.
Pause, then lower slowly and breathe in.

exercises.name: Decline Crunch (Weighted)
exercises.summary: A decline crunch holding a plate against your chest.
steps: Hook your legs over a decline bench and hold a plate on your chest.
Lie back and brace your abs.
Breathe out and curl your shoulders up toward your knees.
Lower slowly and breathe in.

exercises.name: Back Extension (Weighted Hyperextension)
exercises.summary: A hyperextension holding a plate. Add weight only once form is solid.
steps: Set the pad at your hips and lock your ankles under the brace.
Hold a plate against your chest and brace your abs.
Bend at the hips until your hamstrings stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to lift your torso back in line.

exercises.name: Lying Neck Curls (Weighted)
exercises.summary: Neck flexion with a plate. Very light, very slow.
steps: Lie face up on a bench with your head just past the end.
Rest a light plate on your forehead and hold it there.
Tuck your chin and curl your head up toward your chest.
Lower it slowly under control.

exercises.name: Lying Neck Extension (Weighted)
exercises.summary: Neck extension with a plate. Never fast, never forced.
steps: Lie face down on a bench with your head just past the end.
Rest a light plate on the back of your head and hold it.
Lift your head until you are looking forward.
Lower it slowly under control.

exercises.name: Pull Up (Weighted)
exercises.summary: A pull-up with a belt and plate once bodyweight is easy.
steps: Hang a plate from a dip belt around your waist.
Grip the bar just wider than your shoulders and hang.
Pull your chest toward the bar without swinging.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.

exercises.name: Push Up (Weighted)
exercises.summary: A push-up with a plate on your back once bodyweight gets easy.
steps: Have a partner rest a plate across your upper back.
Set your hands just wider than your shoulders and brace hard.
Breathe in and lower until your chest nears the floor.
Press up without letting your hips drop, and breathe out.

exercises.name: Russian Twist (Weighted)
exercises.summary: A seated rotation holding a plate. Turn from the ribs.
steps: Sit with knees bent, holding a plate at your chest.
Lean back to about forty-five degrees and lift your feet.
Rotate your ribs to bring the plate beside one hip.
Rotate to the other side and keep alternating.

exercises.name: Sissy Squat (Weighted)
exercises.summary: A knee-dominant squat holding a plate. Go slowly, the knees work hard.
steps: Hold a plate on your chest and rise onto the balls of your feet.
Hold a support with one hand if you need it.
Lean back and bend your knees, letting them travel forward.
Lower until you feel a deep stretch, then drive back up.

exercises.name: Sit Up (Weighted)
exercises.summary: A sit-up holding a plate on your chest.
steps: Lie on your back with knees bent and a plate held on your chest.
Anchor your feet or keep them flat.
Breathe out and curl all the way up.
Lower slowly and breathe in.

exercises.name: Triceps Dip (Weighted)
exercises.summary: An upright dip with a plate on a belt.
steps: Hang a plate from a dip belt and grip the bars.
Press up to straight arms with your torso upright.
Lower until your elbows reach ninety degrees.
Press back up under control.

exercises.name: Wide Pull Up
exercises.summary: A wider grip, which shifts the pull further onto the lats.
steps: Grip the bar well wider than your shoulders, palms facing away.
Hang with straight arms and pull your shoulders down.
Pull your chest to the bar, driving your elbows down and out.
Lower yourself slowly under control.

exercises.name: Wrist Roller
exercises.summary: Rolling a weight up on a cord. Brutal on the forearms.
steps: Hold the roller out in front at shoulder height.
Roll the cord up by turning the bar hand over hand.
Keep your arms straight and level throughout.
Unroll it slowly under control.

exercises.name: 21s Bicep Curl
exercises.summary: Three grips in one set: halves, top halves, then full curls.
steps: Stand tall and hold the bar with palms up, hands hip-width.
Curl only to elbow height for seven reps.
Curl from elbow height to the top for seven more.
Finish with seven full curls, breathing out as you lift.

exercises.name: Yoga
exercises.summary: A whole-session activity; log the time you spend on it.

exercises.name: Zercher Squat
exercises.summary: A squat with the bar in your elbow crooks. Brutal on the core.
steps: Set the bar at waist height and hook it into your elbow crooks.
Clasp your hands and stand up, keeping the bar tight to your chest.
Brace your abs and breathe in.
Squat down until your elbows reach the inside of your knees.
Push through your heels to stand and breathe out.
